overall.assessment: Prema priloženoj strukturi, podcast uglavnom brani vrijednosti usklađene s katoličkom antropologijom: dostojanstvo djeteta, prvenstvo roditeljske odgovornosti, obiteljsku ulogu majke i oca te shvaćanje spolnosti u okviru ljubavi i odgovornog darivanja sebe. To se podudara s kršćanskim pogledom na osobu kao jedinstvo tijela i duše te s pozivom roditelja da djecu odgajaju za zrelu slobodu i ljubav; ipak, sadržaj same epizode nije dostupan za provjeru njezinih pojedinačnih tvrdnji. Kritički ton prema kurikulumu može biti opravdan, ali formulacije poput borbe protiv biologije i općenita kritika psihologije nose rizik da složena pitanja svedu na sukob ili da zanemare potrebu za točnim dokazima, dijalogom i poštovanjem osoba koje se bore sa svojim spolnim identitetom. Zato je riječ o pretežno kršćanski usmjerenom, ali metodološki i pastoralno ne sasvim uravnoteženom prikazu.
seeds_of_logos: Naglašavanje da roditelji imaju prvu i nezamjenjivu odgovornost za odgoj djece, uključujući spolni i emocionalni odgoj, u skladu je s katoličkim učenjem o obitelji kao primarnom odgojnom okruženju.

Usmjeravanje spolnog odgoja prema ljubavi, uzajamnom darivanju i cjelovitosti osobe, umjesto prema užitku odvojenom od odgovornosti, izražava kršćansko shvaćanje spolnosti kao dimenzije tijela, osjećaja i duše.

Zaštita djetinjstva, pažnja roditelja i naglasak da se djeca ne prepuštaju sama sebi mogu se povezati s biblijskim pozivom da se djecu prima i štiti (Mk 10,14), kao i s dostojanstvom ljudske osobe stvorene na Božju sliku (Post 1,27).
Teme obiteljske svakodnevice, nježnosti, strpljivosti, odgovornosti i odgoja za žrtvu mogu poticati na razumijevanje roditeljstva kao služenja i ljubavi, a ne samo kao privatnog izbora ili tereta.
concerns: Struktura može ostaviti dojam da su biološka opažanja dovoljna za iscrpno razumijevanje osobe i spolnosti. Katoličko učenje uvažava važnost tijela i biološke spolne razlike, ali upozorava i da se ljudska osoba ne smije svesti na biologiju samu.

Naglašeno suprotstavljanje ideologiji i kurikulumima može potisnuti kulturu dijaloga i razlikovanje legitimne kritike ideja od postupanja prema pojedincima s poštovanjem, suosjećanjem i osjetljivošću. Crkveni dokument o rodnoj teoriji izričito spaja pravo roditelja na izbor odgoja s potrebom dijaloga.

Sama struktura ne pokazuje kako su potkrijepljene tvrdnje o dopaminskom sustavu, psihologiji, pristanku, programima u drugim državama ili odgoju dojenčadi. Bez pažljive provjere i nijansiranja takve teme mogu proizvesti strah ili pretjerano pojednostavljenje, umjesto odgovorne zaštite djece i formacije savjesti.
overall.theological_context: Postanak 1,27 i 2,24 pružaju biblijski okvir za dostojanstvo osobe, spolnu razliku i obitelj, dok Isusovo prihvaćanje djece (Mk 10,14) naglašava njihovu posebnu vrijednost i potrebu zaštite. Katekizam i crkveno učenje ovdje treba primjenjivati kroz cjelovitu antropologiju: tijelo je sastavni dio osobe, a spolnost je usmjerena prema ljubavi i darivanju, ne samo prema užitku; Amoris laetitia također upozorava na odvajanje biološkog spola od društvenih uloga, uz poziv da se čovjek prihvaća kao stvorenje. Socijalni nauk Crkve podupire obitelj kao temeljnu društvenu zajednicu i roditeljsko pravo i dužnost odgoja, ali kršćansko svjedočenje treba povezati istinu s dijalogom i poštovanjem dostojanstva svake osobe.

overall.assessment_en: According to the provided outline, the podcast largely defends values aligned with Catholic anthropology: the dignity of the child, the primacy of parental responsibility, the family role of mother and father, and the understanding of sexuality within the framework of love and responsible self-giving. This coincides with the Christian view of the person as a unity of body and soul and with the parents' calling to educate children for mature freedom and love; nevertheless, the content of the episode itself is not available for verifying its individual claims. A critical tone toward the curriculum may be justified, but formulations such as the struggle against biology and generalized criticism of psychology carry the risk of reducing complex issues to conflict or of neglecting the need for accurate evidence, dialogue, and respect for persons struggling with their sexual identity. Therefore, this is a predominantly Christian-oriented, but methodologically and pastorally not entirely balanced presentation.
overall.theological_context_en: Genesis 1:27 and 2:24 provide the biblical framework for the dignity of the person, sexual difference, and the family, while Jesus' welcoming of children (Mk 10:14) emphasizes their special value and the need for protection. The Catechism and Church teaching should be applied here through an integral anthropology: the body is an integral part of the person, and sexuality is directed toward love and self-giving, not merely toward pleasure; Amoris laetitia also warns against separating biological sex from social roles, while calling for accepting the human being as a creature. The social doctrine of the Church supports the family as the fundamental community of society and the parental right and duty of education, but Christian witness must unite truth with dialogue and respect for the dignity of every person.
seeds_of_logos_en: The emphasis that parents have the primary and irreplaceable responsibility for the education of children, including sexual and emotional education, is in accordance with Catholic teaching on the family as the primary educational environment.

Directing sex education toward love, mutual self-giving, and the wholeness of the person, instead of toward pleasure separated from responsibility, expresses the Christian understanding of sexuality as a dimension of body, feelings, and soul.

Protecting childhood, parental attentiveness, and the emphasis that children should not be left to themselves can be connected with the biblical call to receive and protect children (Mk 10:14), as well as with the dignity of the human person created in the image of God (Gen 1:27).

Themes of family daily life, tenderness, patience, responsibility, and education for sacrifice can encourage an understanding of parenthood as service and love, rather than merely as a private choice or burden.
concerns_en: The outline may give the impression that biological observations are sufficient for an exhaustive understanding of the person and sexuality. Catholic teaching acknowledges the importance of the body and biological sexual difference, but also warns that the human person must not be reduced to biology alone.

The pronounced opposition to ideology and curricula may suppress a culture of dialogue and the distinction between legitimate criticism of ideas and treating individuals with respect, compassion, and sensitivity. The Church document on gender theory explicitly combines the right of parents to choose education with the need for dialogue.

The outline itself does not show how the claims about the dopamine system, psychology, consent, programs in other countries, or the upbringing of infants are substantiated. Without careful verification and nuance, such topics can generate fear or oversimplification, rather than the responsible protection of children and the formation of conscience.

sections.subtitle: Prva žena gošća podcasta: doktorica znanosti, supruga i majka
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj pozdravlja Josipu Nemet u studiju i predstavlja je kao prvu ženu gošću podcasta
sections.content:
Epizoda počinje isječkom u kojem gošća oštro ocjenjuje stanje struke koja bi se trebala brinuti o čovjeku. **Josipa Nemet**, doktorica znanosti, kaže da je moderna psihologija u posljednjih dvadesetak do trideset godina "nanijela jako puno štete" i da se degradirala jer je zanemarila biologiju. Prema njezinim riječima, ta struka zaboravlja da se bavi čovjekom "koji nije od jučer", čovjekom "čije tijelo je drevno".

Nakon pozdrava "Hvaljen Isus i Marija i sveti Josip" voditelj podcasta *Redefinicija* predstavlja gošću kao suprugu, majku i doktoricu znanosti koja ima "jednu jako važnu priču". Pita je i kako se osjeća kao prva žena koja gostuje u emisiji.

Josipa Nemet odgovara da za taj podatak nije znala. Kaže da joj je drago i da joj je čast te zahvaljuje voditeljima što se zanimaju za teme važne za djecu i roditelje. Gostovanje vidi i kao podršku radu koji ona i njezini suradnici obavljaju u društvu.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak da psihologija treba uzeti ozbiljno ljudsku tjelesnost načelno je sukladan katoličkoj antropologiji, koja čovjeka razumije kao jedinstvo tijela i duše, a ne kao um odvojen od tijela. Ipak, tvrdnja da je moderna psihologija općenito nanijela veliku štetu ostaje široka i nedokazana u ovom isječku te sama po sebi nije teološki zaključak.
concerns: Opća osuda moderne psihologije nije potkrijepljena konkretnim primjerima ni dokazima u isječku.

Biologija je važna za razumijevanje čovjeka, ali ne iscrpljuje njegovu narav: katoličko učenje razlikuje empirijski opis biološkog poretka od cjelovitog razumijevanja čovjeka kao tjelesnog i duhovnog bića.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko učenje ne prezire tijelo: ono je bitno za osobni identitet i sudjeluje u dostojanstvu čovjeka stvorenog na sliku Božju; biblijska antropologija zato odbacuje dualizam tijela i duše. No biologija, premda važna, nije potpuna antropologija: čovjek je više od predmeta empirijskog opisa, pa njegovo cjelovito razumijevanje uključuje i duhovnu dimenziju. Pozdrav Isusu, Mariji i svetom Josipu u ovom odlomku izražava uobičajenu kršćansku pobožnost i ne sadrži vidljiv naučni problem.

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis that psychology should take human corporeality seriously is in principle consistent with Catholic anthropology, which understands man as a unity of body and soul, and not as a mind separated from the body. However, the claim that modern psychology has generally caused great harm remains broad and unproven in this clip, and is not in itself a theological conclusion.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching does not despise the body: it is essential for personal identity and participates in the dignity of man created in the image of God; biblical anthropology therefore rejects the dualism of body and soul. But biology, although important, is not a complete anthropology: man is more than an object of empirical description, so his comprehensive understanding also includes a spiritual dimension. The greeting to Jesus, Mary, and Saint Joseph in this passage expresses common Christian piety and contains no apparent doctrinal problem.
concerns_en: The general condemnation of modern psychology is not supported by concrete examples or evidence in the clip.

Biology is important for understanding man, but it does not exhaust his nature: Catholic teaching distinguishes the empirical description of the biological order from a comprehensive understanding of man as a bodily and spiritual being.

sections.subtitle_en: First female guest of the podcast: doctor of science, wife, and mother
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host welcomes Josipa Nemet in the studio and introduces her as the first female guest of the podcast
sections.content_en:
The episode begins with a clip in which the guest sharply assesses the state of the profession that should care for man. **Josipa Nemet**, doctor of science, says that modern psychology in the last twenty to thirty years has "caused a great deal of damage" and that it degraded because it neglected biology. According to her words, that profession forgets that it deals with man "who is not from yesterday", man "whose body is ancient".

After the greeting "Praised be Jesus and Mary and Saint Joseph", the host of the podcast *Redefinicija* introduces the guest as a wife, mother, and doctor of science who has "a very important story". He also asks her how she feels as the first woman to guest on the show.

Josipa Nemet replies that she did not know that fact. She says that she is glad and honored, and thanks the hosts for being interested in topics important to children and parents. She also sees the guest appearance as support for the work that she and her collaborators do in society.

sections.subtitle: Kako je riječki kurikulum ušao u škole kroz "rupu u zakonu"
sections.screenshot_description: Josipa Nemet objašnjava kako je kurikulum zdravstvenog odgoja ušao u riječke škole kao izvannastavna aktivnost
sections.content:
Glavna tema razgovora je analiza kurikuluma zdravstvenog odgoja koju je Josipa Nemet napravila sa suradnicima. Ona objašnjava da je program prošle godine bio u pilot fazi u Rijeci, a ove se godine provodi u gotovo svim riječkim školama. Zasad se izvodi kao **izvannastavna aktivnost**.

Prema njezinim riječima, kurikulum je u škole ušao kroz "rupu u zakonu". Ta je mogućnost bila predviđena za projekte poput paške čipke te glazbenih i plesnih aktivnosti, kojima udruge popunjavaju dio dječjeg vremena. Grad Rijeka iskoristio ju je za uvođenje vlastite verzije zdravstvenog odgoja.

Gošća naglašava da takav program nije bio potreban jer nacionalni kurikulum već ima **međupredmetnu temu Zdravlje**. Ona pokriva i spolno zdravlje, pa učenici u osmom razredu uče o vrstama kontracepcije. I taj sadržaj smatra "vrlo diskutabilnim". Gradskoj vlasti to ipak nije bilo dovoljno. Josipa Nemet tvrdi da se ona ugledala na inozemne istomišljenike koji su društvenim aktivizmom svoje programe uveli u nacionalne kurikulume. Rezultat je, kaže, "vrlo loš i štetan kurikulum" u koji su "infiltrirane i određene stavke rodne ideologije".

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ne iznosi izravnu tvrdnju o vjeri ili moralu koja bi proturječila katoličkom nauku; istodobno, sama kritika načina uvođenja kurikuluma ne pokazuje kakav je njegov sadržaj ni poštuju li se roditeljska prava. Katolički nauk podupire roditeljsku primarnu odgovornost za odgoj djece, uključujući spolni i afektivni odgoj, ali iz ovog sažetka nije moguće utvrditi je li ona u konkretnom slučaju bila zanemarena.
concerns: Izraz „rupa u zakonu” iznosi pravnu ocjenu koju ovaj odlomak ne potkrepljuje pojedinostima; njezinu točnost nije moguće procijeniti samo na temelju sažetka.
Bez podataka o nastavnom sadržaju, načinu informiranja roditelja i mogućnosti njihova sudjelovanja ne može se zaključiti da kurikulum promiče rodnu ideologiju ili da krši katolička načela.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk smatra obitelj primarnim odgojnim okruženjem i roditeljsku odgovornost za obrazovanje djece opisuje kao pravo i dužnost koja se ne može u cijelosti prepustiti drugima. Odgojne aktivnosti izvan obitelji mogu podupirati roditelje, ali spolni odgoj treba provoditi uz njihovo prihvaćanje i pažljivo vodstvo. Zato je za teološku procjenu važnije ispitati stvarni sadržaj kurikuluma i odnos prema roditeljima nego samo to, kao organizacijsku činjenicu, je li riječ o izvannastavnoj aktivnosti.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage does not make a direct claim about faith or morals that would contradict Catholic teaching; at the same time, the mere criticism of the manner in which the curriculum was introduced does not show what its content is or whether parental rights are respected. Catholic teaching supports parents' primary responsibility for the education of children, including sexual and affective education, but from this summary it is not possible to determine whether it was neglected in this specific case.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching considers the family to be the primary educational environment and describes parental responsibility for the education of children as a right and duty that cannot be entirely surrendered to others. Educational activities outside the family can support parents, but sexual education should be carried out with their acceptance and careful guidance. Therefore, for a theological assessment, it is more important to examine the actual content of the curriculum and the relationship toward parents than merely the organizational fact of whether it is an extracurricular activity.
concerns_en: The expression "legal loophole" presents a legal assessment that this passage does not substantiate with details; its accuracy cannot be assessed solely on the basis of the summary.

Without data on the instructional content, the manner of informing parents, and the possibility of their participation, it cannot be concluded that the curriculum promotes gender ideology or that it violates Catholic principles.

sections.subtitle_en: How the Rijeka curriculum entered schools through a "legal loophole"
sections.screenshot_description_en: Josipa Nemet explains how the health education curriculum entered Rijeka schools as an extracurricular activity
sections.content_en:
The main topic of the conversation is the analysis of the health education curriculum that Josipa Nemet conducted with collaborators. She explains that the program was in a pilot phase in Rijeka last year, and this year it is being implemented in almost all Rijeka schools. For now, it is carried out as an **extracurricular activity**.

According to her words, the curriculum entered schools through a "legal loophole". That possibility was intended for projects such as Pag lace and musical and dance activities, with which associations fill part of children's time. The City of Rijeka used it to introduce its own version of health education.

The guest emphasizes that such a program was not needed because the national curriculum already has the **cross-curricular topic Health**. It also covers sexual health, so students in eighth grade learn about types of contraception. She also considers that content "very debatable". Yet that was not enough for the city authorities. Josipa Nemet claims that they looked up to foreign like-minded individuals who, through social activism, introduced their programs into national curriculums. The result is, she says, a "very bad and harmful curriculum" into which "certain items of gender ideology have also been infiltrated".

sections.subtitle: Od majčinske stanke do znanstvene i pravne analize
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća opisuje kako se uključila u borbu nakon što joj je sin krenuo u vrtić
sections.content:
Josipa Nemet otkriva i osobni razlog uključivanja. Neko je vrijeme bila u "fazi mirovanja" i nije bila društveno aktivna jer je bila kod kuće sa sinom. Kad je sin na jesen krenuo u vrtić, dobila je prostor za angažman.

Na to ju je potaknula moralna obveza, ali i struka, jer dolazi iz znanstvenog miljea. Odlučila se suprotstaviti programu koji ideološki aktivisti, kako kaže, predstavljaju kao znanstveni odgoj. Po njezinu mišljenju on "nema nikakve veze sa znanošću" i nema uporište u neurorazvojnoj znanosti ni u pedagogiji.

Okupila se šira skupina ljudi koja je odlučila javno progovoriti:
- roditelji,
- ljudi koji vole djecu, ali svoje nemaju,
- učitelji,
- pravnici.

Prvi im je cilj bio pokazati javnosti što kurikulum sadrži. Josipa Nemet ga je detaljno analizirala i s pravnog stajališta. Tvrdi da se njime posredno krše pojedini zakoni, među njima i odredbe Kaznenog zakona o pristanku djeteta na spolni odnos. Smatra da se roditeljima uskraćuje i pravo na **informirani pristanak**. Roditelji koji su pristali na pilot projekt i ovogodišnje sudjelovanje, prema njezinim riječima, nisu bili propisno informirani o sadržaju programa.

magisterium.assessment: Osobno i javno zauzimanje za odgoj djece, kao i zahtjev da se obrazovni programi kritički razmotre u svjetlu znanja i savjesti, načelno su u skladu s katoličkim naglaskom na odgovornosti roditelja i laika. Ipak, iz ulomka se ne može zaključiti je li tvrdnja da program „nema nikakve veze sa znanošću” opravdana, a izraz „ideološki aktivisti” ostaje polemička ocjena, ne dokazana činjenica.
concerns: Odlomak je prekinut prije dovršetka tvrdnje o tome što programu navodno nedostaje, pa se ne mogu procijeniti njezini konkretni znanstveni, pravni ni činjenični temelji.

Katolički nauk podupire angažman za odgoj djece, ali taj angažman ne zamjenjuje potrebu za preciznim dokazima, pravednim prikazom suprotnih stavova i poštovanjem osoba koje zastupaju drugačije pristupe.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva naglašava da roditelji imaju nezamjenjivu odgojnu odgovornost, dok kršćanske zajednice i škole trebaju podupirati njihovu zadaću; istodobno se priznaje pravo odgojitelja na prigovor savjesti. Crkva također ne odbacuje znanstvene spoznaje: one mogu pridonijeti odgovornom roditeljstvu i odgoju, ali se trebaju povezati s moralnom prosudbom i dostojanstvom ljudske osobe. U tom smislu, evanđeosko „ljubiti bližnjega kao sebe” (Mt 19,19) traži da se rasprava o odgoju vodi istinito i odgovorno, bez svođenja protivnika na etikete.

magisterium.assessment_en: Personal and public advocacy for the upbringing of children, as well as the demand that educational programs be critically examined in the light of knowledge and conscience, are in principle in line with the Catholic emphasis on the responsibility of parents and laypeople. However, it cannot be concluded from the excerpt whether the claim that the program "has nothing to do with science" is justified, and the expression "ideological activists" remains a polemical assessment, not a proven fact.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church emphasizes that parents have an irreplaceable educational responsibility, while Christian communities and schools should support their task; at the same time, the right of educators to conscientious objection is recognized. The Church also does not reject scientific findings: they can contribute to responsible parenthood and education, but they need to be connected with moral judgment and the dignity of the human person. In that sense, the evangelical "love your neighbor as yourself" (Mt 19:19) requires that the discussion on education be conducted truthfully and responsibly, without reducing opponents to labels.
concerns_en: The excerpt is cut off before the completion of the claim about what the program allegedly lacks, so its concrete scientific, legal, or factual foundations cannot be assessed.

Catholic teaching supports engagement for the upbringing of children, but that engagement does not replace the need for precise evidence, a fair presentation of opposing views, and respect for persons who represent different approaches.

sections.subtitle_en: From a maternal break to scientific and legal analysis
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest describes how she got involved in the struggle after her son started kindergarten
sections.content_en:
Josipa Nemet also reveals a personal reason for getting involved. For some time, she was in a "dormant phase" and was not socially active because she was at home with her son. When her son started kindergarten in the fall, she gained room for engagement.

She was prompted to do so by a moral obligation, but also by her profession, because she comes from a scientific milieu. She decided to oppose a program that ideological activists, as she says, present as scientific education. In her opinion, it "has nothing to do with science" and has no basis in neurodevelopmental science or pedagogy.

A broader group of people gathered who decided to speak out publicly:
- parents,
- people who love children, but do not have their own,
- teachers,
- lawyers.

Their first goal was to show the public what the curriculum contains. Josipa Nemet analyzed it in detail from a legal perspective as well. She claims that certain laws are indirectly violated by it, among them provisions of the Criminal Code regarding a child's consent to sexual intercourse. She believes that parents are also denied the right to **informed consent**. Parents who consented to the pilot project and this year's participation, according to her words, were not properly informed about the content of the program.

sections.subtitle: Rodna ideologija i "epistemološka zbunjenost" djece
sections.screenshot_description: Josipa Nemet govori o dovođenju djece u stanje epistemološke zbunjenosti
sections.content:
Prvi problematični dio kurikuluma koji gošća izdvaja jest rodna ideologija. Djecu se, tvrdi, dovodi u stanje **epistemološke zbunjenosti**. Sugerira im se da njihov dojam, mišljenje i samoodređenje vrijede više od objektivne istine.

Zbog toga djeca dobivaju, kako kaže, "neprimjerenu autonomiju nad objektivnom istinom", a za nju još nisu sposobna zbog stupnja neurobiološkog razvoja. Pojmovi se miješaju, pa se dijete uvjerava da njegov spol može biti jednak rodu, da može biti različit od roda ili da može biti "nikakav".

magisterium.assessment: Kritika ideje da se osobni identitet može potpuno odvojiti od tjelesne spolne stvarnosti uglavnom je usklađena s katoličkom antropologijom, koja čovjeka razumije kao jedinstvo tijela i duše te odbacuje shvaćanje slobode kao proizvoljnog samoodređenja. Ipak, tvrdnje o „epistemološkoj zbunjenosti” i neurobiološkoj nesposobnosti djece nisu same po sebi nauk Crkve te ih treba obrazložiti konkretnim sadržajem kurikuluma i pouzdanim dokazima.
concerns: Odlomak može ostaviti dojam da je svaka razlika između pojmova „spol” i „rod” protivna katoličkom nauku. Crkveni dokument priznaje da se ti pojmovi mogu razlikovati, a problem vidi u njihovu razdvajanju kada se rod shvaća kao potpuno neovisan o biološkom spolu ili kao isključivo osobni izbor.

Tvrdnja da djeca zbog neurobiološkog razvoja nisu sposobna za određenu razinu autonomije nije potkrijepljena priloženim crkvenim izvorima. Crkveni dokument kaže da djeca i mladi još nisu dosegli punu zrelost i da im je potrebna primjerena, pažljiva formacija, ali ne utvrđuje ovdje neurobiološki argument iz odlomka.

Opis kurikuluma kao takvog nije moguće neovisno provjeriti na temelju priloženog ulomka. Teološka procjena zato se odnosi na iznesene tvrdnje, a ne na potvrdu da kurikulum doista poučava sve što mu se pripisuje.
magisterium.enrichment: Kongregacija za katolički odgoj u dokumentu *Muško i žensko stvori ih* uči da se identitet ne smije svesti ni na biološki opis ni na neograničen izbor pojedinca: tijelo je sastavni dio osobe, ali osoba je jedinstvo tjelesne i duhovne stvarnosti. Dokument smatra da se pojmovi spol i rod mogu razlikovati, no upozorava na njihovo razdvajanje kada se identitet odvaja od tjelesne spolne razlike. Ujedno traži odgoj primjeren dobi koji mladima pomaže razvijati kritičko rasuđivanje, pa kritika obrazovnog sadržaja treba biti precizna, istinita i usmjerena na cjelovitost i dostojanstvo djeteta.

magisterium.assessment_en: Criticism of the idea that personal identity can be completely separated from bodily sexual reality is generally aligned with Catholic anthropology, which understands man as a unity of body and soul and rejects the understanding of freedom as arbitrary self-determination. Nevertheless, claims about "epistemological confusion" and the neurobiological incapacity of children are not in themselves the teaching of the Church and should be substantiated with the concrete content of the curriculum and reliable evidence.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Congregation for Catholic Education in the document *Male and Female He Created Them* teaches that identity must not be reduced either to a biological description or to the unlimited choice of an individual: the body is an integral part of the person, but the person is a unity of bodily and spiritual reality. The document considers that the concepts of sex and gender can be distinguished, but warns against their separation when identity is separated from bodily sexual difference. At the same time, it calls for age-appropriate education that helps young people develop critical discernment, so criticism of educational content should be precise, truthful, and directed toward the integrity and dignity of the child.
concerns_en: The passage may leave the impression that any distinction between the concepts of "sex" and "gender" is contrary to Catholic teaching. The Church document acknowledges that these concepts can be distinguished, seeing the problem in their separation when gender is understood as completely independent of biological sex or as exclusively a personal choice.

The claim that children, due to neurobiological development, are not capable of a certain level of autonomy is not substantiated by the provided Church sources. The Church document states that children and young people have not yet reached full maturity and need appropriate, careful formation, but it does not establish here the neurobiological argument from the passage.

The description of the curriculum as such cannot be independently verified on the basis of the provided excerpt. The theological assessment therefore refers to the stated claims, and not to a confirmation that the curriculum truly teaches everything attributed to it.

sections.subtitle_en: Gender ideology and "epistemological confusion" of children
sections.screenshot_description_en: Josipa Nemet speaks about bringing children into a state of epistemological confusion
sections.content_en:
The first problematic part of the curriculum that the guest highlights is gender ideology. Children are, she claims, brought into a state of **epistemological confusion**. It is suggested to them that their impression, opinion, and self-determination are worth more than objective truth.

Because of this, children receive, as she says, "inappropriate autonomy over objective truth", and they are not yet capable of it due to the stage of neurobiological development. Concepts are mixed up, so the child is convinced that their sex can be equal to gender, that it can be different from gender, or that it can be "none".

sections.subtitle: Spolni užitak u prvom planu i dječji dopaminski sustav
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća objašnjava kako kurikulum cilja na dječji nagradni sustav u mozgu
sections.content:
Josipa Nemet kao posebno osjetljivo područje navodi spolnost. Kaže da kurikulum snažno ističe **spolni užitak** i da je spolnost "amputirana" od svoje glavne, biološke svrhe, a to je reprodukcija. U udžbenicima i ishodima kurikuluma reprodukcija se, prema njezinim riječima, tretira kao nešto suvišno, a naglasak je na djetetovu pravu na užitak.

Naglašavanje užitka po njoj posredno cilja na osjetljivost djetetova **nagradnog sustava u mozgu**, odnosno dopaminskog sustava. Objašnjava da je to jedini sustav koji je kod djeteta zaista razvijen. Kurikulum dijete gura da se njime koristi, a izostaje socijalna modulacija, odnosno vođenje od strane okoline. Djetetu se kaže "ti možeš sam izabrati", iako ono to još ne može.

Prema njezinu objašnjenju, djetetu nedostaju **regulatorne sinapse**. One omogućuju da procijeni posljedice svog ponašanja, da planira i da nagone uskladi s moralnim načelima zajednice, društvenim normama i vlastitim iskustvima. Kurikulum ga ipak, ističe gošća, uporno uvjerava da je ono to koje ima pravo pristati.

magisterium.assessment: Upozorenje da se spolnost ne svede na sebični užitak i odvoji od otvorenosti životu uglavnom je u skladu s katoličkim naukom. Ipak, tvrdnja da je reprodukcija njezina glavna svrha može biti nepotpuna ako zanemaruje i sjedinjujuće značenje bračne ljubavi, dok tvrdnja o dječjem dopaminskom sustavu nije potvrđena navedenim teološkim izvorima.
concerns: Katolički nauk ne prikazuje užitak sam po sebi kao nešto loše: bračni užitak smatra dobrim kada je uključen u uzajamno darivanje supružnika i življen u skladu s moralnim redom.
Opis spolnosti prvenstveno kroz reprodukciju riskira zanemariti njezino sjedinjujuće značenje i njezinu povezanost s ljubavlju, cijelom osobom i bračnim darivanjem.

Navod da je dopaminski sustav jedini uistinu razvijen sustav kod djeteta te tvrdnja da naglašavanje užitka posredno cilja na njega nisu teološke tvrdnje, a priloženi izvori ne pružaju osnovu za njihovu znanstvenu procjenu.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk povezuje sjedinjujuće i prokreativno značenje bračnog čina: spolnost je poziv na darivanje osobe u ljubavi, otvoreno životu, a ne puko traženje užitka ili samo biološka funkcija. Istodobno, bračni užitak može biti dobar dar, pod uvjetom da je življen s umjerenošću i unutar uzajamnog sebedarja supružnika. U odgoju djece važno je spojiti istinito, uzrastu primjereno poučavanje s čistoćom, moralnim vrednotama i poštovanjem roditeljske odgovornosti.
magisterium.assessment_en: The warning that sexuality should not be reduced to selfish pleasure and separated from openness to life is generally in line with Catholic teaching. However, the claim that reproduction is its primary purpose may be incomplete if it neglects the unitive meaning of marital love as well, while the claim regarding the child's dopamine system is not confirmed by the cited theological sources.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching links the unitive and procreative meanings of the marital act: sexuality is a call to the self-giving of the person in love, open to life, and not the mere pursuit of pleasure or only a biological function. At the same time, marital pleasure can be a good gift, provided it is lived with temperance and within the mutual self-giving of spouses. In the education of children, it is important to combine truthful, age-appropriate instruction with chastity, moral values, and respect for parental responsibility.
concerns_en: Catholic teaching does not portray pleasure in itself as something evil: it considers marital pleasure good when it is integrated into the mutual self-giving of the spouses and lived in accordance with the moral order.
Describing sexuality primarily through reproduction risks neglecting its unitive meaning and its connection to love, the whole person, and marital self-giving.

The statement that the dopamine system is the only truly developed system in a child and the claim that emphasizing pleasure indirectly targets it are not theological assertions, and the provided sources do not provide a basis for their scientific evaluation.

sections.subtitle_en: Sexual pleasure at the forefront and the child's dopamine system
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest explains how the curriculum targets the child's reward system in the brain
sections.content_en:
Josipa Nemet cites sexuality as an especially sensitive area. She says that the curriculum strongly emphasizes **sexual pleasure** and that sexuality is "amputated" from its primary, biological purpose, which is reproduction. In textbooks and curriculum outcomes, reproduction is, according to her words, treated as something superfluous, while the emphasis is on the child's right to pleasure.

The emphasis on pleasure, in her view, indirectly targets the sensitivity of the child's **reward system in the brain**, namely the dopamine system. She explains that this is the only system that is truly developed in a child. The curriculum pushes the child to use it, while social modulation, meaning guidance from the environment, is absent. The child is told "you can choose for yourself," even though it cannot do so yet.

According to her explanation, the child lacks **regulatory synapses**. They make it possible to evaluate the consequences of one's behavior, to plan, and to align drives with the moral principles of the community, social norms, and one's own experiences. The curriculum, the guest emphasizes, nevertheless persistently convinces the child that it is the one who has the right to consent.

sections.subtitle: Zašto je pojam "pristanka" za djecu sporan
sections.screenshot_description: Josipa Nemet objašnjava problematiku pojma pristanka u kontekstu djece
sections.content:
Gošća posebno kritizira termin **pristanka**. Tvrdi da je on "duboko ukorijenjen u pedofilskom narativu prema djeci". U toj se retorici inzistira na tome da dijete ima pravo pristati, a ako pristane, "sve je dozvoljeno".

Josipa Nemet podsjeća da su društvo i pravo dosad dijete smatrali razvojno izrazito osjetljivim bićem. Zato mu se do 18. godine ne dopušta kupnja cigareta ili alkohola ni vožnja automobila. Javni i pravni život, kaže, prepoznaje da dijete ne može donositi dobre i slobodne odluke za sebe pa umjesto njega odlučuje zajednica. Kurikulum, po njezinu mišljenju, uvodi iznimku samo za spolnost i sugerira da dijete može ravnopravno sudjelovati u spolnom životu iako još nije spolno zrelo.

Pojašnjava da pod spolnom zrelošću ne misli samo na tijelo. Spolno sazrijeva i dječji mozak, u kojem se nalaze "tisuće i tisuće" receptora za spolne hormone.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na to da djecu treba štititi i da djetetov pristanak ne opravdava seksualno iskorištavanje dobro je usklađen s katoličkim shvaćanjem dostojanstva i ranjivosti djece. Međutim, tvrdnja da je sam pojam „pristanka” duboko ukorijenjen u pedofilskom narativu te da se njime poručuje kako je, ako dijete pristane, „sve dozvoljeno” preširoka je i nije potkrijepljena dostupnim crkvenim izvorima.
concerns: Izjednačavanje rasprave o pristanku s pedofilskim narativom može nepravedno poistovjetiti zaštitno poučavanje djece o granicama, osobnoj sigurnosti i traženju pomoći s opravdavanjem seksualnog iskorištavanja. Dostupni izvori potvrđuju potrebu zaštite djece, ali ne podupiru tu opću optužbu.

Usporedba s dobi za kupnju alkohola, cigareta ili vožnju ne dokazuje sama po sebi da dijete ne može donositi nikakvu slobodnu odluku; valja razlikovati sposobnost za pojedine odluke od pristanka koji bi navodno opravdao seksualni odnos s odraslom osobom.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički izvori ističu da djeca zbog razvojne nezrelosti i neravnopravnog odnosa s odraslom osobom nisu u jednakom položaju slobode te da ni djetetova inicijativa ne uklanja odgovornost odrasloga za zlostavljanje. Crkva također upozorava da preuranjene spolne informacije mogu štetiti dječjem razvoju, dok istodobno naglašava dužnost odlučne zaštite dostojanstva i sigurnosti djece. U evanđeoskom svjetlu, Isusova posebna briga za djecu i ozbiljno upozorenje protiv sablažnjavanja „malih” podupiru zaštitu djece, ali ne opravdavaju pripisivanje zle namjere svakom obrazovnom govoru o pristanku.

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis that children need to be protected and that a child's consent does not justify sexual exploitation is well aligned with the Catholic understanding of the dignity and vulnerability of children. However, the claim that the very concept of "consent" is deeply rooted in a pedophilic narrative and that it communicates that, if a child consents, "everything is permitted" is too broad and is not substantiated by available Church sources.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic sources emphasize that children, due to developmental immaturity and an unequal relationship with an adult, are not in an equal position of freedom, and that not even a child's initiative removes an adult's responsibility for abuse. The Church also warns that premature sexual information can harm a child's development, while simultaneously emphasizing the duty of decisive protection of the dignity and safety of children. In the evangelical light, Jesus' special care for children and serious warning against scandalizing the "little ones" support the protection of children, but do not justify attributing evil intent to every educational discourse on consent.
concerns_en: Equating the discussion about consent with a pedophilic narrative can unfairly identify protective teaching of children about boundaries, personal safety, and seeking help with the justification of sexual exploitation. Available sources confirm the need to protect children, but do not support this broad accusation.

The comparison with the age for purchasing alcohol, cigarettes, or driving does not prove in itself that a child cannot make any free decision; one should distinguish the capacity for individual decisions from consent that would allegedly justify sexual relations with an adult.

sections.subtitle_en: Why the concept of "consent" for children is contentious
sections.screenshot_description_en: Josipa Nemet explains the issue of the concept of consent in the context of children
sections.content_en:
The guest particularly criticizes the term **consent**. She claims that it is "deeply rooted in the pedophilic narrative towards children". In this rhetoric, it is insisted that a child has the right to consent, and if they consent, "everything is permitted".

Josipa Nemet recalls that society and law have so far considered a child to be a developmentally extremely sensitive being. That is why until the age of 18, purchasing cigarettes or alcohol or driving a car is not permitted to them. Public and legal life, she says, recognizes that a child cannot make good and free decisions for themselves, so the community decides instead of them. The curriculum, in her opinion, introduces an exception only for sexuality and suggests that a child can participate equally in sexual life even though they are not yet sexually mature.

She clarifies that by sexual maturity she does not mean only the body. A child's brain matures sexually as well, in which "thousands and thousands" of sex hormone receptors are located.

sections.subtitle: Bez modela odgode, kontracepcija obrađena površno
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća govori o izostanku modela odgode i štetnim učincima kontracepcije koji se ne spominju
sections.content:
Josipa Nemet kritizira i obradu zaštite. Kaže da kurikulum potpuno zaobilazi model koji smatra najuspješnijim i najzdravijim za djecu: **odgodu do sposobnosti za trajnu i vjernu vezu**. Taj stav, ističe, ne zastupa samo iz svjetonazorskih razloga nego i iz pozicije biologije. Prema njezinu objašnjenju, sustav vezivanja razvio se kod čovjeka jer je odrastanje ljudskog mladunčeta zahtjevno i traži dugotrajno ulaganje. Zato je najbolji model onaj u kojem su majka i otac trajno i vjerno povezani.

Kontracepcija se u kurikulumu, kaže, obrađuje površno, samo nabrajanjem metoda. Prvi se put spominje i takozvana **urgentna kontracepcija**, koje nema u međupredmetnoj temi Zdravlje. Gošća tvrdi da je riječ o abortivnom sredstvu, a ne o kontracepciji.

Najvećim problemom, prisutnim i u nacionalnom kurikulumu, smatra to što se ne navode štetni učinci kontraceptivnih sredstava. Ako se već inzistira na informiranju djece, kaže, treba ih informirati potpuno. Iako je to tabu tema i teško je dobiti projekt za takva istraživanja, navodi da danas postoje desetci radova o štetnim posljedicama. Spominje:
- srčane i moždane udare,
- smanjenje gustoće kostiju,
- upale i trajnu neplodnost kod spirale,
- neplodnost nakon dugotrajne upotrebe hormonske kontracepcije.

Gošća dodaje da djetetu informacija sama po sebi malo znači. U emotivnoj i "dopaminski nabijenoj" situaciji ono se oslanja na limbički sustav, koji traži trenutnu nagradu. Inhibicijske sinapse koje bi mu rekle "Stani, čekaj, usporedi, pa odluči" još nisu razvijene. Zato je, kaže, kod djeteta najvažnije izgraditi osjećaj vanjske norme. Pritom ne misli na sram nego na svijest da je nešto za njega ne samo trenutno nego i trajno štetno. Kao veliki propust navodi i izostanak teme pornografije, koju opisuje kao najrašireniju i najozbiljniju bihevioralnu ovisnost današnjice.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na to da je spolna suzdržanost prije trajne, vjerne veze uglavnom sukladan katoličkom pozivu na čistoću, ali katolički nauk spolne odnose ne veže samo uz dovoljno ozbiljnu ili trajnu vezu nego uz brak. Tvrdnje o biološkim učincima i o tome da je određeni obiteljski model „najzdraviji” ne mogu se potvrditi na temelju dostupnog ulomka i navedenih izvora.
concerns: Izraz „do sposobnosti za trajnu i vjernu vezu” može se shvatiti kao da su spolni odnosi dopušteni čim veza postane trajna i vjerna; katolički nauk ih, međutim, čuva za brak, u kojem su sjedinjeni vjernost i otvorenost životu.

Biološko objašnjenje o sustavu vezivanja i tvrdnja da je trajna povezanost majke i oca najbolji model izneseni su kao znanstveni zaključci, ali dostupni izvori ne potvrđuju te specifične empirijske tvrdnje.

Ulomak je prekinut prije razrade kontracepcije, hitne kontracepcije i pornografije, pa se njihove konkretne tvrdnje ne mogu teološki ocijeniti. Dostupni izvori ne sadrže ni izravne biblijske odlomke za provjeru navoda.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveno razumijevanje čistoće nije samo preporuka odgađanja spolnog odnosa: čistoća oblikuje seksualnu želju tako da odgovara dostojanstvu osobe i stvarnosti odnosa, a za bračne parove uključuje vjernost i otvorenost mogućnosti novog života. Zato bi katolički prikaz trebao jasno razlikovati odgađanje spolnih odnosa do braka od odgađanja do trenutka kada se procijeni da je veza dovoljno trajna. Crkva također smatra da kontracepcija nije isto što i odgovorno planiranje obitelji: bračni parovi mogu razborito odlučivati o vremenu rođenja djece, ali bez namjernog zatvaranja bračnog čina životu.

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis that sexual abstinence before a lasting, faithful relationship is largely in accordance with the Catholic call to chastity, but Catholic teaching links sexual intercourse not merely to a sufficiently serious or lasting relationship, but to marriage. Claims about biological effects and about a certain family model being the "healthiest" cannot be confirmed on the basis of the available excerpt and the cited sources.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church's understanding of chastity is not merely a recommendation to delay sexual intercourse: chastity shapes sexual desire so that it corresponds to the dignity of the person and the reality of the relationship, and for married couples it includes fidelity and openness to the possibility of new life. Therefore, a Catholic presentation should clearly distinguish delaying sexual intercourse until marriage from delaying until a moment when a relationship is assessed to be sufficiently lasting. The Church also holds that contraception is not the same as responsible family planning: married couples may prudently decide on the timing of the birth of children, but without intentionally closing the marital act to life.
concerns_en: The expression "until the capacity for a lasting and faithful relationship" can be understood as though sexual intercourse is permitted as soon as a relationship becomes lasting and faithful; Catholic teaching, however, reserves it for marriage, in which fidelity and openness to life are united.

The biological explanation of the bonding system and the claim that the permanent connection of mother and father is the best model are presented as scientific conclusions, but the available sources do not confirm these specific empirical claims.

The excerpt is cut off before the elaboration of contraception, emergency contraception, and pornography, so their specific claims cannot be theologically evaluated. The available sources also do not contain direct biblical passages to verify the statements.

sections.subtitle_en: Without the delay model, contraception addressed superficially
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest speaks about the absence of the delay model and the harmful effects of contraception that are not mentioned
sections.content_en:
Josipa Nemet also criticizes the treatment of protection. She says that the curriculum completely bypasses the model she considers most successful and healthiest for children: **delay until the capacity for a lasting and faithful relationship**. That stance, she points out, she advocates not only for worldview reasons but also from the position of biology. According to her explanation, the bonding system developed in humans because raising a human offspring is demanding and requires long-term investment. Therefore, the best model is the one in which the mother and father are permanently and faithfully connected.

Contraception in the curriculum, she says, is addressed superficially, merely by listing methods. For the first time, so-called **emergency contraception** is also mentioned, which is not present in the cross-curricular topic Health. The guest claims that it is an abortifacient, not contraception.

She considers the biggest problem, also present in the national curriculum, to be that the harmful effects of contraceptive methods are not stated. If informing children is already insisted upon, she says, they should be informed completely. Although it is a taboo topic and it is difficult to obtain a project for such research, she states that today there are dozens of papers on harmful consequences. She mentions:
- heart attacks and strokes,
- reduction in bone density,
- inflammations and permanent infertility with the IUD,
- infertility after long-term use of hormonal contraception.

The guest adds that information in itself means little to a child. In an emotional and "dopamine-charged" situation, it relies on the limbic system, which seeks immediate reward. Inhibitory synapses that would tell it "Stop, wait, compare, then decide" are not yet developed. Therefore, she says, what is most important in a child is building a sense of an external norm. In doing so, she does not mean shame, but the awareness that something is for it not only momentarily but also permanently harmful. As a major omission, she also cites the absence of the topic of pornography, which she describes as the most widespread and serious behavioral addiction today.

sections.subtitle: Pobačaj kao "rješenje", a roditelji izvan jednadžbe
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj i gošća razgovaraju o tome kako kurikulum predstavlja pobačaj i zaobilazi roditelje
sections.content:
Voditelja zanima kako kurikulum pristupa pobačaju. Josipa Nemet potvrđuje da se pobačaj navodi kao jedno od rješenja u slučaju neželjene trudnoće. Ni u jednom trenutku se, kaže, ne spominje da se time nekom biću oduzima život.

Jednako problematičnim smatra to što se nigdje ne spominje **savjetovanje s roditeljima**. Kad se mlade upućuje da potraže pomoć ako im nije dobro, uvijek ih se usmjerava stručnjacima. Roditelji se ne spominju kao osobe koje mogu pomoći u izazovnoj situaciji, pri ozbiljnoj odluci ili u emocionalno nestabilnom stanju.

Voditelj zaključuje da su roditelji "izvan svake jednadžbe", a gošća se s tim slaže. On dodaje da takav zdravstveni odgoj vidi kao vrstu **ideološkog preodgoja** koji nameće ranu seksualizaciju, a kao neizravnu posljedicu ima raspad društva.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim naukom jer kritizira predstavljanje pobačaja kao mogućeg rješenja, što je u skladu s naukom da je nerođeni ljudski život dostojan zaštite. Naglasak na roditeljskoj potpori može biti vrijedan, ali sam odlomak ne dokazuje da je izostavljanje roditelja iz kurikuluma samo po sebi povreda katoličkog nauka.
concerns: Opis kurikuluma prenosi tvrdnju govornice, ali se iz dostavljenog odlomka ne može neovisno provjeriti je li pobačaj doista predstavljen kao rješenje niti u kojem kontekstu.

Ne treba zaključiti da roditelji moraju biti jedini izvor pomoći ili da izostanak izričitog spominjanja roditelja automatski predstavlja teološki prijestup; dostavljeni izvori ne utvrđuju takvo pravilo.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva uči da je nerođeno dijete ljudski život koji treba štititi te da je pobačaj namjerno uništenje nedužnog nerođenog djeteta; zato je njegovo predstavljanje kao rješenja moralno nespojivo s katoličkim naukom. Sveto pismo ne osuđuje pobačaj izravno i posebnim izrazom, ali njegovo poštovanje života u majčinoj utrobi podupire primjenu zapovijedi „Ne ubij“ i na nerođeno dijete. Crkveni odgovor uključuje pomoć i potporu ženama i parovima koji se suočavaju s iskušenjem pobačaja, no navedeni izvori ne određuju posebna pravila o tome kada se mladi moraju savjetovati s roditeljima.

citations.document_title: Africae Munus
Evangelium Vitae

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is largely aligned with Catholic teaching because it criticizes the presentation of abortion as a possible solution, which is in accordance with the teaching that unborn human life is worthy of protection. The emphasis on parental support can be valuable, but the passage itself does not prove that omitting parents from the curriculum is in itself a violation of Catholic teaching.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church teaches that the unborn child is a human life that should be protected and that abortion is the deliberate destruction of an innocent unborn child; therefore, presenting it as a solution is morally incompatible with Catholic teaching. Sacred Scripture does not condemn abortion directly and with a specific term, but its respect for life in the mother's womb supports the application of the commandment "You shall not kill" to the unborn child as well. The Church's response includes help and support for women and couples facing the temptation of abortion, but the cited sources do not establish specific rules on when young people must consult with parents.
concerns_en: The description of the curriculum conveys the speaker's claim, but from the provided passage it cannot be independently verified whether abortion is indeed presented as a solution or in what context.

One should not conclude that parents must be the only source of help or that the absence of explicit mention of parents automatically constitutes a theological transgression; the provided sources do not establish such a rule.

sections.subtitle_en: Abortion as a "solution", and parents out of the equation
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host and the guest discuss how the curriculum presents abortion and bypasses parents
sections.content_en:
The host is interested in how the curriculum approaches abortion. Josipa Nemet confirms that abortion is cited as one of the solutions in the case of unwanted pregnancy. At no point, she says, is it mentioned that this takes the life of a being.

She considers it equally problematic that **consultation with parents** is nowhere mentioned. When young people are directed to seek help if they are not well, they are always directed to professionals. Parents are not mentioned as persons who can help in a challenging situation, during a serious decision, or in an emotionally unstable state.

The host concludes that parents are "out of every equation", and the guest agrees with this. He adds that he sees such health education as a type of **ideological re-education** that imposes early sexualization, and as an indirect consequence has the breakdown of society.

sections.subtitle: Rascjep spolnosti i reprodukcije kao presedan u biološkoj povijesti
sections.screenshot_description: Josipa Nemet kao biologinja govori o rascjepu spolnosti od reprodukcije
sections.content:
Josipa Nemet nastavlja na voditeljevu misao: društvo se najlakše mijenja preko djece, odnosno preko normi koje se upisuju u njihovu neurobiologiju, osobito kroz spolni moral. Sadašnje stanje vidi kao neizbježnu posljedicu "ogromnog rascjepa" koji se dogodio prije pedesetak godina.

Kao biologinja taj rascjep naziva **presedanom** u 4,5 milijardi godina dugoj povijesti života. Pojavilo se, kaže, biće koje smatra da se nije dobro razmnožavati, a na kraju i biće koje više ne misli da je dobro živjeti. Ilustrira to primjerom: stanice nemaju svijest, ali se uvijek bore za život. I kod osobe koja si pokušava oduzeti život, kaže, "sve njegove stanice se s njim ne slažu". Time objašnjava velik broj neuspjelih pokušaja samoubojstva.

Biologija, objašnjava, teži preživljavanju do razmnožavanja. Čovjek kao svjesno biće uz to ima i višu dimenziju: slobodno se odlučuje voljeti drugu osobu. Ipak, obrasci su duboko upisani u tijelo. Odnos muškog i ženskog opisuje kao "jako finu i osjetljivu regulaciju ravnoteže". Muške i ženske gamete postoje gotovo dvije milijarde godina i uvijek su koevoluirale, pa je svaka promjena kod jednog spola tražila komplementarnu promjenu kod drugog. Sve te promjene vodile su zajedništvu i stvaranju života.

Nasuprot toj povijesti stoji "jadnih 50 godina", na koje se biologija ne može prilagoditi. Najprije je spolnost odvojena od reprodukcije, a zatim i užitak, koji je evolucijski mlađi, star oko petsto milijuna godina, a nastao je da potiče razmnožavanje. Danas je, kaže, spolni odnos postao isključivo sredstvo užitka, a čovjek koristi svoje i tuđe tijelo za zadovoljenje dopaminskih potreba i nagona.

Korijen problema vidi u trenutku kad je žena odvojena od "najljepše dimenzije svoje ženstvenosti", odnosno od majčinstva. Kao posljedicu navodi tvrdnju da je ubijanje nerođenog djeteta svake godine glavni uzrok smrti u svijetu. Majku koja u tome sudjeluje vidi i kao žrtvu tog procesa.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak da odgojne predodžbe mogu oblikovati odnos prema spolnosti i životu te upozorenje na razdvajanje spolnosti od rađanja djelomično su u skladu s katoličkim naukom, koji povezuje spolnost, ljubav i otvorenost životu. Ipak, tvrdnje o „presedanu” u povijesti života i o društvenom uzroku koji vodi od nerađanja do nijekanja vrijednosti života iz ovoga sažetka djeluju kao široke biološke i uzročne generalizacije, a ne kao utvrđene teološke tvrdnje.
concerns: Tvrdnja da je riječ o presedanu u 4,5 milijardi godina povijesti života zahtijeva znanstveno obrazloženje; dostupni teološki izvori ne potvrđuju takvu evolucijsko-biološku ocjenu.

Sažetak povezuje odbacivanje razmnožavanja s mišlju da nije dobro živjeti. Takva uzročna veza nije dokazana u navedenom sadržaju, a može nepravedno izjednačiti različite osobne okolnosti i razloge zbog kojih pojedinci ili parovi nemaju djecu.
Izraz da se norme „upisuju u neurobiologiju” može spolni moral prikazati redukcionistički ako se zanemare sloboda, savjest, odnosi i duhovna dimenzija osobe.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk smatra da bračna spolnost ima sjedinjujuće i rađajuće značenje te upozorava na namjerno razdvajanje tih dimenzija, ali ne tvrdi da svaki bračni čin mora začeti dijete. Crkva istodobno priznaje odgovorno roditeljstvo: supružnici mogu, iz ozbiljnih razloga i poštujući moralni zakon, odgoditi novo rođenje, dok ostaju pozvani na otvorenost i služenje životu. Stoga je korisno razlikovati kritiku kulture koja dijete vidi kao prijetnju od prosudbe pojedinaca čiji životni položaj ili odluke mogu imati različite uzroke.

The Truth and Meaning of Human Sexuality: Guidelines for Education Within the Family
citations.document_author: The Pontifical Council for the Family

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis that educational ideas can shape the attitude toward sexuality and life, as well as the warning regarding the separation of sexuality from procreation, are partially aligned with Catholic teaching, which unites sexuality, love, and openness to life. Nevertheless, the claims about a "precedent" in the history of life and about a social cause leading from not giving birth to the denial of the value of life in this summary appear as broad biological and causal generalizations, rather than established theological claims.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching holds that marital sexuality has a unitive and procreative meaning and warns against the intentional separation of these dimensions, but it does not claim that every marital act must conceive a child. At the same time, the Church recognizes responsible parenthood: spouses may, for serious reasons and respecting the moral law, postpone a new birth, while remaining called to openness and service to life. Therefore, it is useful to distinguish the critique of a culture that sees a child as a threat from the judgment of individuals whose life situation or decisions may have various causes.
concerns_en: The claim that this is a precedent in 4.5 billion years of life history requires scientific justification; available theological sources do not confirm such an evolutionary-biological evaluation.

The summary connects the rejection of reproduction with the thought that it is not good to live. Such a causal link is not proven in the stated content, and it may unjustly equate different personal circumstances and reasons why individuals or couples do not have children.

The expression that norms are "inscribed into neurobiology" can present sexual morality reductionistically if freedom, conscience, relationships, and the spiritual dimension of the person are disregarded.

sections.subtitle_en: The rift between sexuality and reproduction as a precedent in biological history
sections.screenshot_description_en: Josipa Nemet, as a biologist, speaks about the rift between sexuality and reproduction
sections.content_en:
Josipa Nemet continues on the host's thought: society is most easily changed through children, that is, through the norms that are inscribed into their neurobiology, especially through sexual morality. She sees the current state as an inevitable consequence of the "huge rift" that occurred about fifty years ago.

As a biologist, she calls that rift a **precedent** in the 4.5-billion-year-long history of life. A being appeared, she says, that considers that it is not good to reproduce, and in the end a being that no longer thinks that it is good to live. She illustrates this with an example: cells have no consciousness, but they always fight for life. Even with a person trying to take their own life, she says, "all of their cells do not agree with them." With this, she explains the large number of failed suicide attempts.

Biology, she explains, strives for survival until reproduction. Man as a conscious being alongside this also has a higher dimension: he freely decides to love another person. Nevertheless, the patterns are deeply inscribed into the body. She describes the relationship between male and female as a "very fine and sensitive regulation of balance." Male and female gametes have existed for almost two billion years and have always coevolved, so every change in one sex demanded a complementary change in the other. All those changes led to communion and the creation of life.

Opposite to that history stand "a pitiful 50 years," to which biology cannot adapt. First, sexuality was separated from reproduction, and then pleasure, which is evolutionarily younger, about five hundred million years old, and arose to stimulate reproduction. Today, she says, sexual intercourse has become exclusively a means of pleasure, and man uses his own body and someone else's body to satisfy dopamine needs and urges.

She sees the root of the problem in the moment when woman was separated from "the most beautiful dimension of her femininity," that is, from motherhood. As a consequence, she cites the claim that the killing of the unborn child every year is the main cause of death in the world. She also sees the mother who participates in this as a victim of that process.

sections.subtitle: Što molekularni biolog ima sa zdravstvenim odgojem: kritika psihologije
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća kritizira modernu psihologiju zbog zanemarivanja biologije
sections.content:
Voditelj spominje kritiku na koju je naišao pri pripremi: što molekularni biolog ima s temom zdravstvenog odgoja? Smatra da je gošća u dotadašnjem razgovoru dala "pregršt argumenata" zašto se time može baviti i ona i svaki čovjek.

Josipa Nemet ponavlja misao iz uvodnog isječka. Moderna psihologija degradirala se jer je zanemarila da je ljudsko tijelo drevno i nosi određene obrasce. Zato ju je oduševilo što studij psihologije na **Hrvatskom katoličkom sveučilištu** ima predmet evolucijska psihologija. Čovjeka se, kaže, ne može razumjeti bez povijesti koju njegovo tijelo nosi "do trenutka kad je Gospodin udahnuo ljudsku dušu". Ni sociologija ni psihologija ne mogu se promatrati izvan okvira biologije.

Zbog toga su stručnjaci, prema njezinim riječima, zbunjeni porastom anksioznosti i suicidalnosti. Ona korijen toga vidi u iskoraku društva od onoga što je duboko u čovjeku. Spominje i **Jungove arhetipe** te priče i mitove kojima se to prenosilo. Kad se društvo udalji od tih intrinzičnih struktura, dolazi do dezintegracije i destabilizacije osobe. Terapije koje se svode na to da se osoba dobro osjeća smatra promašenima jer osjećaji nisu glavni pojam u psihoterapiji. Dodaje da ne želi ulaziti u tuđu struku jer bi to bilo neprofesionalno, ali kao evolucijska biologinja vidi "veliko neznanje".

Najviše ju je šokiralo, kaže, kad je proučila predmete na studiju psihologije: biologije ima vrlo malo, a ozbiljne neurobiologije gotovo nimalo. Jednoj je kolegici objasnila da ta znanja "nisu ušla u sustav obrazovanja". Prema njezinim riječima, studenti barataju razinom biologije koju njezina kći već zna u prvom razredu srednje škole. Roditelji čija djeca studiraju psihologiju u Rijeci poslali su joj prezentaciju s predavanja vezanog uz biologiju. Ocjenjuje je "tragičnom" i "infiltriranom ideologijom" koja ne stvara stručnjake nego ideološke aktiviste.

Gošća poziva državu da zaštiti obrazovni sustav. Podsjeća da su hrvatski stručnjaci u svijetu bili cijenjeni i lako dobivali postdoktorska mjesta. Posljedice vidi već danas: djeca s identitetskim problemima dolaze kod psihologa koje je, kako kaže, "odgojila ideologija na Filozofskom fakultetu".

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak da se čovjeka ne može razumjeti zanemarujući njegovo tijelo i biološku povijest uglavnom je spojiv s katoličkim pogledom na čovjeka kao jedinstvo tijela i duše, a evolucijska psihologija može biti legitimno područje istraživanja. Ipak, tvrdnja da se moderna psihologija općenito „degradirala” preširoka je i u ulomku nije potkrijepljena, pa je ne treba predstavljati kao katolički nauk.
concerns: Izraz „degradirala se” može nepravedno generalizirati o psihologiji kao disciplini; iz dostavljenog ulomka ne proizlazi dokaz za tako opću ocjenu.
Biološki i evolucijski obrasci mogu rasvijetliti čovjekovo tjelesno stanje, ali ne smiju svesti osobu na biologiju niti zanemariti njezinu duhovnu narav, slobodu i dostojanstvo.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko učenje ne postavlja tijelo i dušu kao odvojene dijelove osobe: čovjek je jedinstvo tjelesnog i duhovnog, a tjelesnost je bitna za osobni identitet. Crkva dopušta istraživanje evolucije ljudskoga tijela, ali ustraje na tome da se ljudska osoba ne može objasniti samo evolucijom materije i da je duhovna duša neposredno stvorena od Boga.

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis that man cannot be understood by neglecting his body and biological history is largely compatible with the Catholic view of man as a unity of body and soul, and evolutionary psychology can be a legitimate field of research. Nevertheless, the claim that modern psychology has generally "degraded" is too broad and is not substantiated in the excerpt, so it should not be presented as Catholic teaching.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching does not posit the body and soul as separate parts of the person: man is a unity of the bodily and the spiritual, and corporeality is essential for personal identity. The Church permits research into the evolution of the human body, but insists that the human person cannot be explained solely by the evolution of matter and that the spiritual soul is immediately created by God.
concerns_en: The expression "degraded" may unfairly generalize about psychology as a discipline; from the provided excerpt, no evidence follows for such a general assessment.
Biological and evolutionary patterns can shed light on man's bodily condition, but they must not reduce the person to biology or neglect his spiritual nature, freedom, and dignity.

sections.subtitle_en: What a Molecular Biologist Has to Do with Health Education: A Critique of Psychology
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest criticizes modern psychology for neglecting biology
sections.content_en:
The host mentions a criticism he encountered during preparation: what does a molecular biologist have to do with the topic of health education? He believes that in the conversation up to that point, the guest provided a "handful of arguments" as to why both she and every person can deal with this.

Josipa Nemet repeats the thought from the introductory clip. Modern psychology has degraded because it neglected that the human body is ancient and carries certain patterns. That is why she was thrilled that the psychology study program at the **Hrvatsko katoličko sveučilište** has an evolutionary psychology course. Man, she says, cannot be understood without the history that his body carries "up to the moment when the Lord breathed in the human soul". Neither sociology nor psychology can be observed outside the framework of biology.

Because of this, experts, according to her words, are confused by the increase in anxiety and suicidality. She sees the root of this in society's step away from what is deep inside man. She also mentions **Jungian archetypes** and the stories and myths through which this was transmitted. When society distances itself from these intrinsic structures, disintegration and destabilization of the person occur. She considers therapies that boil down to making the person feel good to be failures because feelings are not the main concept in psychotherapy. She adds that she does not want to enter someone else's profession because that would be unprofessional, but as an evolutionary biologist she sees "great ignorance".

What shocked her most, she says, was when she studied the courses in the psychology degree program: there is very little biology, and almost no serious neurobiology. She explained to a colleague that this knowledge "did not enter the education system". According to her words, students operate with a level of biology that her daughter already knows in the first grade of high school. Parents whose children study psychology in Rijeka sent her a presentation from a lecture related to biology. She evaluates it as "tragic" and "infiltrated with ideology" that does not produce experts but ideological activists.

The guest calls on the state to protect the educational system. She recalls that Croatian experts were valued in the world and easily obtained postdoctoral positions. She sees the consequences already today: children with identity problems come to psychologists whom, as she says, "ideology at the Filozofski fakultet raised".

sections.subtitle: "Ovo nije sukob svjetonazora, nego borba protiv biologije"
sections.screenshot_description: Josipa Nemet govori o jednom jedinom znanstvenom radu u bibliografiji kurikuluma
sections.content:
Na voditeljevu opasku da znanstveni radovi zagovornicima kurikuluma "ne idu u prilog", Josipa Nemet odgovara da se ne radi o sukobu svjetonazora. Po njoj je to **borba protiv biologije**. S protivnicima ne želi razgovarati jezikom svjetonazora, nego jezikom znanosti. Tvrdi da oni to ne mogu jer od 40 milijuna znanstvenih radova iz medicine i biologije ne mogu naći nijedan koji bi poduprio njihove teze. Zato, kaže, uglavnom izbjegavaju rasprave.

U bibliografiji kurikuluma, prema njezinim riječima, nalazi se samo jedan znanstveni rad. Ostalo su naputci **Svjetske zdravstvene organizacije**, **Europske unije** i drugih tijela, u kojima također nema radova o neurobiologiji i dječjem razvoju. Taj jedini rad, kaže, analizirao je uspješnost sveobuhvatne seksualne edukacije i pokazao pozitivan učinak na znanje djece. Gošća to smatra trivijalnim: dijete će zapamtiti i ponoviti ono što mu se ponavlja. To, međutim, neće usmjeriti njegovo ponašanje kad mora odlučivati, zbog osjetljive neurobiologije i sklonosti riziku koja je u adolescenciji veća nego ikad u životu.

Iznosi i drugu mogućnost: možda idejni začetnici takvog pristupa sve to dobro znaju i zato žele što ranije doći do djece kako bi promijenili njihov normativni sustav. Produljeno djetinjstvo je, objašnjava, faza u kojoj zajednica uvodi nove članove u kulturu. Citira **Chestertona**, prema kojem se odgojem prenosi "sama duša kulture". Zato odgojitelje, pod čime misli na učitelje i roditelje, smatra najvažnijim osobama u društvu. Upozorava da će, ako se autoritet nad neurobiologijom djece u javnom sustavu prepusti ideolozima, društvo za dvadeset godina biti upravo onakvo kakvo danas samo bira.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na biološkoj stvarnosti spolne razlike može biti u skladu s katoličkom antropologijom, koja tijelo smatra važnim za identitet osobe, a ne nečim odvojenim od nje. Ipak, tvrdnja da je riječ samo o „borbi protiv biologije” te da se protivna stajališta ne mogu znanstveno poduprijeti iznesena je preširoko i bez dokaza u prikazanom odlomku, pa ne ispunjava katolički poziv na pažljivo slušanje i razborit dijalog.
concerns: Tvrdnja da se ne radi o sukobu svjetonazora može prikriti činjenicu da se rasprava tiče i antropoloških i vrijednosnih pretpostavki, a ne samo empirijskih podataka.
Apsolutna tvrdnja o 40 milijuna znanstvenih radova nije potkrijepljena u odlomku; znanstvene tvrdnje valja obrazlagati provjerljivim dokazima, a ne oslanjati se na neprovjerenu brojku.
Prikaz protivnika kao onih koji ne mogu odgovoriti znanošću i zato izbjegavaju rasprave može zatvoriti dijalog i ne razlikuje pojedine teorije od šireg istraživanja roda.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potvrđuje da se biološka spolna razlika može znanstveno utvrđivati, ali istodobno upozorava da se biološki red ne smije poistovjetiti s cjelovitim redom ljudske naravi i njezinim odnosom prema Bogu Stvoritelju. U dokumentu o obrazovanju Crkva razlikuje rodne ideologije od istraživanja roda koje može pridonijeti razumijevanju načina na koji se spolna razlika živi u različitim kulturama, te predlaže pristup koji uključuje slušanje, razumsko razmatranje i iznošenje kršćanskog pogleda. Zato se katolička kritika treba oslanjati na pouzdane znanstvene nalaze, ali i jasno izložiti antropološke razloge, bez svođenja cijele rasprave na sukob s biologijom.
