magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on the biological reality of sexual difference can be in accordance with Catholic anthropology, which considers the body important for the identity of the person, rather than something separate from it. However, the claim that it is only a "fight against biology" and that opposing viewpoints cannot be scientifically supported is stated too broadly and without evidence in the presented excerpt, and thus does not fulfill the Catholic call to careful listening and prudent dialogue.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church affirms that biological sexual difference can be scientifically established, but at the same time warns that the biological order must not be equated with the integral order of human nature and its relationship to God the Creator. In the document on education, the Church distinguishes gender ideologies from gender research that can contribute to understanding the ways in which sexual difference is lived in different cultures, and proposes an approach that includes listening, reasoned consideration, and presenting the Christian view. Therefore, Catholic critique should rely on reliable scientific findings, but also clearly present anthropological reasons, without reducing the entire debate to a conflict with biology.
concerns_en: The claim that it is not a clash of worldviews may conceal the fact that the debate also concerns anthropological and value-based assumptions, and not only empirical data.
The absolute claim about 40 million scientific papers is not substantiated in the excerpt; scientific claims should be justified with verifiable evidence, rather than relying on an unverified figure.
The portrayal of opponents as those who cannot respond with science and therefore avoid debates can close dialogue and does not distinguish individual theories from broader gender research.

sections.subtitle_en: "This is not a clash of worldviews, but a fight against biology"
sections.screenshot_description_en: Josipa Nemet speaks about a single scientific paper in the bibliography of the curriculum
sections.content_en:
To the host's remark that scientific papers "are not in favor of" the proponents of the curriculum, Josipa Nemet responds that it is not about a clash of worldviews. According to her, it is a **fight against biology**. She does not want to speak with opponents in the language of worldviews, but in the language of science. She claims that they cannot do so because out of 40 million scientific papers in medicine and biology, they cannot find a single one that would support their theses. That is why, she says, they mostly avoid debates.

In the curriculum's bibliography, according to her words, there is only one scientific paper. The rest are guidelines of the **World Health Organization**, the **European Union**, and other bodies, in which there are also no papers on neurobiology and child development. That single paper, she says, analyzed the effectiveness of comprehensive sexuality education and showed a positive effect on children's knowledge. The guest considers this trivial: a child will remember and repeat what is repeated to it. This, however, will not guide its behavior when it must make decisions, due to sensitive neurobiology and a propensity for risk that is greater in adolescence than ever in life.

She also presents another possibility: perhaps the conceptual initiators of such an approach know all this well and therefore want to reach children as early as possible in order to change their normative system. Prolonged childhood is, she explains, a phase in which the community introduces new members into culture. She quotes **Chesterton**, according to whom upbringing transmits "the very soul of culture". That is why she considers educators, by which she means teachers and parents, to be the most important persons in society. She warns that if authority over children's neurobiology in the public system is surrendered to ideologues, in twenty years society will be exactly as it chooses today.

sections.subtitle: Niska sklonost strahu i "lakša opcija" djelovanja
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća objašnjava zašto je strah ne sputava u javnom angažmanu
sections.content:
Voditelj pita što je bio presudni "klik" da se uključi u **udrugu Članak 64** i javni angažman. Podsjeća da je ona viša asistentica na institutu i pita boji li se za radno mjesto ili obitelj. Kaže da poznaje ljude iz znanstvenog sustava koji se zbog posla, članaka i citiranosti ne žele javno izjasniti. Njega su, kaže, zbog stavova neki i "unfriendali".

Josipa Nemet odgovara da to ovisi o karakteru i osobinama ličnosti. Spominje **neurotičnost**, odnosno sklonost strahu, koja je u populaciji široko raspoređena. Dobro je za zajednicu da ima ljude na oba kraja tog spektra jer se odluke tako izbalansiraju. Za sebe kaže da ima "izrazito nisku" neurotičnost i da njome strah ne upravlja. Dodaje da bi joj možda bilo bolje da je bliže sredini. Žene, objašnjava, češće naginju neurotičnosti, pa u braku nastaje "lijepa vaga" pri donošenju odluka.

Oslonac vidi i u svojoj duhovnosti te se vodi **Sokratovom** mišlju da je jedino loše što se čovjeku može dogoditi ono što sam loše učini. Lošim smatra i propustiti učiniti dobro za društvo. Motivira je i velika ljubav prema djeci, ne samo svojoj, jer ih vidi kao stvorenja koja zaslužuju šansu.

U tom kontekstu spominje pojam "zarobljene savjesti" koji je koristio **papa Benedikt** te riječi **svetog Pavla** da "duh hoće, ali tijelo ne može". Sloboda, kaže, nije zadovoljavanje svakog nagona, nego sposobnost da se odluči što je dobro za sebe, za bližnjega i za zajednicu. Za sebe kaže da joj je teže promatrati i pasivno slušati "ružne priče" koje se nameću djeci nego djelovati. Uključivanje joj je zato, priznaje, "lakša opcija, a ne teža".

magisterium.assessment: U prikazanom dijelu naglasak na hrabrosti, slobodnom djelovanju i ljubavi prema djeci može biti u skladu s kršćanskim shvaćanjem odgovornog svjedočenja; kršćanski poziv „ne bojte se” ne znači da osoba nikada ne osjeća strah. Budući da je odlomak prekinut, a spominjanje „zarobljene savjesti” nije dovoljno objašnjeno, nije moguće procijeniti cjelokupnu teološku argumentaciju.
concerns: Ako se oklijevanje s javnim istupom pripisuje prvenstveno neurotičnosti ili manjku hrabrosti, postoji opasnost da se nepravedno prosuđuju tuđi motivi i okolnosti; strah je ljudski osjećaj koji Biblija ne poriče, a i Isus je iskusio tjeskobu.

Izraz „zarobljena savjest” može biti teološki nejasan bez dodatnog konteksta: savjest i sloboda zahtijevaju razborito oblikovanje, ali sam sažetak ne otkriva tvrdi li govornica nešto što bi bilo protivno katoličkom nauku.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćanska hrabrost nije odsutnost straha, nego povjerenje u Boga koje pomaže da strah ne upravlja konačno našim izborima; Ivan Pavao II. upozorava da strah može ograničiti slobodu odlučivanja. Ljubav prema djeci podrazumijeva njihovo dobro i dostojanstvo, a katoličko učenje potvrđuje i važnu ulogu roditelja i odgojitelja u njihovu obrazovanju. Ipak, hrabro svjedočenje treba biti spojeno s razboritošću i poštovanjem osoba, a ne s brzopletim zaključcima o onima koji se javno ne izjašnjavaju.

citations.document_title: 3 September 1989: Holy Mass on the feast of Saint Sebastian at Castel Gandolfo - Homily
General Audience of 11 February 2015: The family - 4. The children
Amoris Laetitia
Acta Apostolicae Sedis: Issue 3, 2018

magisterium.assessment_en: In the presented section, the emphasis on courage, free action, and love for children can be in accordance with the Christian understanding of responsible witnessing; the Christian call "do not be afraid" does not mean that a person never feels fear. Since the excerpt is cut off, and the mention of "captive conscience" is not sufficiently explained, it is not possible to assess the entire theological argumentation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Christian courage is not the absence of fear, but trust in God that helps fear not to ultimately govern our choices; John Paul II warns that fear can limit the freedom of decision-making. Love for children implies their good and dignity, and Catholic teaching also confirms the important role of parents and educators in their education. Nevertheless, courageous witnessing should be joined with prudence and respect for persons, rather than with hasty conclusions about those who do not speak out publicly.
concerns_en: If hesitation to speak publicly is attributed primarily to neuroticism or a lack of courage, there is a danger of unfairly judging the motives and circumstances of others; fear is a human emotion that the Bible does not deny, and Jesus Himself experienced anguish.

The phrase "captive conscience" can be theologically unclear without additional context: conscience and freedom require prudent formation, but the summary itself does not reveal whether the speaker asserts anything that would be contrary to Catholic teaching.

sections.subtitle_en: Low inclination to fear and the "easier option" of action
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest explains why fear does not hold her back in public engagement
sections.content_en:
The host asks what the decisive "click" was to get involved in the **udruga Članak 64** and public engagement. He recalls that she is a senior assistant at an institute and asks whether she fears for her job or family. He says that he knows people from the scientific system who, because of work, articles, and citation metrics, do not want to state their views publicly. Due to his views, some people even "unfriended" him, he says.

Josipa Nemet responds that this depends on character and personality traits. She mentions **neuroticism**, that is, an inclination to fear, which is widely distributed across the population. It is good for the community to have people on both ends of that spectrum because decisions are thus balanced out. Regarding herself, she says that she has "extremely low" neuroticism and that fear does not control her. She adds that perhaps it would be better for her to be closer to the middle. Women, she explains, tend toward neuroticism more often, so in marriage a "nice balance" emerges when making decisions.

She also sees support in her spirituality and is guided by **Socrates'** thought that the only bad thing that can happen to a man is what he himself does badly. She also considers it bad to fail to do good for society. She is also motivated by a great love for children, not only her own, because she sees them as creatures who deserve a chance.

In that context, she mentions the concept of a "captive conscience" used by **Pope Benedict** and the words of **Saint Paul** that "the spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak". Freedom, she says, is not satisfying every urge, but the ability to decide what is good for oneself, for one's neighbor, and for the community. For herself, she says that it is harder for her to watch and passively listen to "ugly stories" being imposed on children than to act. Getting involved is therefore, she admits, "the easier option, not the harder one" for her.

sections.subtitle: Od "Karata na stol" do udruge nazvane po ustavnom članku
sections.screenshot_description: Josipa Nemet objašnjava kako je inicijativa Karte na stol prerasla u udrugu Članak 64
sections.content:
Voditelj pita odakle ime udruge i što je dosad postignuto. Josipa Nemet objašnjava da su počeli kao inicijativa **Karte na stol**. Naziv je bio privlačan jer su tada bile aktualne "karte seksalice", pa su pozvali da se otvore i njihove i vlastite karte. Održan je i prosvjed. Kako se okupilo više ljudi, uključujući pravni i administrativni tim, zaključili su da je za djelovanje u društvu najjednostavnije osnovati udrugu.

Ime **Članak 64** dolazi od članka Ustava koji smatraju "zadnjom branom" zdravog i radosnog djetinjstva pred ideološkim pritiscima. Taj članak, objašnjava, roditeljima jamči pravo da donose konačnu odluku o odgoju svoje djece. Zakoni se mijenjaju lako i često "iza kulisa", pa se zaštita djece i prava roditelja postupno slabe. Ustav je krovni dokument koji se ne mijenja tako lako. Zato je, ističe, važno stalno se pozivati na to pravo, jer roditelj ima najveću ljubav prema djetetu i prirodni nagon da mu čini dobro kad dobije pravu informaciju.

magisterium.assessment: Opis osnivanja udruge, inicijative i prosvjeda sam po sebi ne proturječi katoličkom nauku; katolički izvori potvrđuju da su roditelji prvi odgojitelji te imaju pravo i dužnost sudjelovati u odgoju djece. Budući da je izvadak prekinut prije dovršetka tvrdnje o članku 64. Ustava, nije moguće procijeniti šire tvrdnje udruge o kurikulumu ili njihov ustavni argument.
concerns: Nedovršen izvadak ne omogućuje provjeru što se točno podrazumijeva pod tvrdnjom da je članak 64. „zadnja brana” niti je li kritika kurikuluma u nastavku pravedno i činjenično utemeljena.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk roditeljsko pravo na odgoj smatra izvornim i nezamjenjivim, ali ne apsolutnim: ono je povezano s odgovornošću roditelja za dobro djeteta i treba se ostvarivati u skladu s moralnim zakonom. Država i drugi odgojni čimbenici imaju legitimnu ulogu, no trebaju surađivati s obitelji, a ne preuzeti njezinu primarnu odgovornost.

magisterium.assessment_en: The description of the founding of the association, the initiative, and the protest does not in itself contradict Catholic teaching; Catholic sources confirm that parents are the primary educators and have the right and duty to participate in the upbringing of their children. Since the excerpt is cut off before the completion of the claim regarding Article 64 of the Constitution, it is not possible to assess the association's broader claims regarding the curriculum or their constitutional argument.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching considers the parental right to education to be original and irreplaceable, but not absolute: it is linked to the parents' responsibility for the good of the child and should be exercised in accordance with the moral law. The state and other educational agents have a legitimate role, but they should cooperate with the family rather than assume its primary responsibility.
concerns_en: The incomplete excerpt does not allow for verification of what exactly is meant by the claim that Article 64 is the "last bulwark", nor whether the critique of the curriculum that follows is just and factually grounded.

sections.subtitle_en: From "Cards on the Table" to an association named after a constitutional article
sections.screenshot_description_en: Josipa Nemet explains how the initiative Karte na stol grew into the association Članak 64
sections.content_en:
The host asks where the name of the association comes from and what has been achieved so far. Josipa Nemet explains that they started as the initiative **Karte na stol**. The name was catchy because "sex cards" were topical at the time, so they called for both their cards and their own cards to be put on the table. A protest was also held. As more people gathered, including a legal and administrative team, they concluded that founding an association was the simplest way to operate in society.

The name **Članak 64** comes from the article of the Constitution that they consider the "last bulwark" of a healthy and joyful childhood against ideological pressures. That article, she explains, guarantees parents the right to make the final decision regarding the upbringing of their children. Laws change easily and often "behind the scenes", so the protection of children and the rights of parents are gradually weakened. The Constitution is an umbrella document that is not changed so easily. Therefore, she emphasizes, it is important to constantly invoke that right, because a parent has the greatest love for the child and a natural instinct to do good for them when given the right information.

sections.subtitle: Web stranica sa znanstvenim sadržajem za roditelje
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća predstavlja web stranicu udruge sa znanstvenim člancima za roditelje
sections.content:
Glavni smjer djelovanja udruge, objašnjava Josipa Nemet, jest da "ne mogu djelovati mimo roditelja". Rade preko njih i računaju da će roditelj, kad dobije istinitu informaciju, dobro procijeniti i odlučiti za svoje dijete.

Uz društvene mreže odmah su počeli izrađivati **web stranicu**, na koju redovito dodaju:
- znanstvena istraživanja,
- stručne članke i analize o dječjem neurorazvoju,
- sadržaje o štetnosti ovisničkih obrazaca, osobito pornografije.

Cilj je da roditelji "crno na bijelo" pročitaju da je ono na što ih udruga upozorava znanstveno potvrđeno. Objavljuju i članke o događanjima u inozemstvu. Hrvatska, kaže, "srećom kasni" i u lošim stvarima. Vani se sveobuhvatna seksualna edukacija provodi već 15 do 20 godina, a današnje su verzije znatno ekstremnije od riječkih početaka. Stranica tako treba pokazati što nas čeka za deset ili dvadeset godina ako se ne reagira na vrijeme.

magisterium.assessment: Opis djelovanja udruge uglavnom je usklađen s katoličkim naglaskom na primarnoj odgovornosti roditelja za odgoj djece te na zaštiti djece od pornografije. Sam odlomak ne iznosi dovoljno sadržaja da bi se procijenile konkretne tvrdnje web-stranice ili njezina kritika kurikuluma, pa se ocjena odnosi samo na prikazani pristup informiranju roditelja.
concerns: Nije moguće provjeriti točnost ni kvalitetu istraživanja i stručnih analiza koje stranica objavljuje.
Izraz „ovisnički obrasci” treba primjenjivati precizno: odlomak sam po sebi ne dokazuje da je svako izlaganje pornografiji ovisnost niti pruža pojedinačne znanstvene nalaze.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk roditeljima pripisuje izvorno, primarno i nezamjenjivo pravo i dužnost odgoja djece, uključujući spolni i osjećajni odgoj, dok druge ustanove trebaju podupirati, a ne zamijeniti obitelj. Crkveni dokument posebno prepoznaje pornografiju kao ozbiljnu opasnost za djecu i podupire preventivno i kritičko poučavanje roditelja, pa je usmjerenost na informiranje roditelja u tom pogledu primjerena. Ipak, spolni odgoj treba biti cjelovit i primjeren dobi, usmjeren prema dostojanstvu osobe i odgoju za ljubav, a ne svesti se samo na upozoravanje na štetnosti.

magisterium.assessment_en: The description of the association's activity is mostly aligned with the Catholic emphasis on the primary responsibility of parents for the upbringing of children and on the protection of children from pornography. The passage itself does not provide enough content to evaluate the specific claims of the website or its critique of the curriculum, so the assessment refers only to the presented approach of informing parents.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching attributes to parents the original, primary, and irreplaceable right and duty to educate their children, including sexual and affective education, while other institutions should support, not replace, the family. Church documents specifically recognize pornography as a serious danger to children and support the preventive and critical instruction of parents, so the focus on informing parents is appropriate in this regard. Nevertheless, sexual education should be integral and age-appropriate, directed toward the dignity of the person and education for love, rather than being reduced merely to warning about harmful effects.
concerns_en: It is not possible to verify the accuracy or quality of the research and professional analyses published by the website.
The term "addictive patterns" should be applied precisely: the passage in itself does not prove that every exposure to pornography is an addiction, nor does it provide specific scientific findings.

sections.subtitle_en: A website with scientific content for parents
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest presents the association's website with scientific articles for parents
sections.content_en:
The main direction of the association's action, Josipa Nemet explains, is that "they cannot act bypassing the parents". They work through them and count on the fact that a parent, when they receive true information, will evaluate well and decide for their child.

Along with social media, they immediately began creating a **website**, to which they regularly add:
- scientific research,
- professional articles and analyses on children's neurodevelopment,
- content on the harmfulness of addictive patterns, especially pornography.

The goal is for parents to read "in black and white" that what the association is warning them about is scientifically confirmed. They also publish articles about events abroad. Croatia, she says, "fortunately is lagging behind" in bad things as well. Abroad, comprehensive sexuality education has been implemented for 15 to 20 years already, and today's versions are considerably more extreme than the beginnings in Rijeka. The website is thus meant to show what awaits us in ten or twenty years if action is not taken in time.

sections.subtitle: Francuska: obvezni program od treće godine i otežano školovanje kod kuće
sections.screenshot_description: Josipa Nemet opisuje iskustva francuskih roditelja s nacionalnim kurikulumom spolnog odgoja
sections.content:
Josipa Nemet spominje konferenciju na koju su pozvani roditelji iz **Francuske**, gdje je, kako kaže, program došao "do krajnjih granica". Francuski nacionalni kurikulum naziva "degutantnim" i ističe da je obvezan i u katoličkim školama. Zato je hrvatska retorika o povlačenju djece iz programa za francuske prilike nedostatna.

Francuski su roditelji počeli školovati djecu kod kuće, ali je država, kaže, i to maksimalno ograničila. Za razliku od Amerike, gdje je dovoljno reći "hoću homeschoolati", u Francuskoj roditelji moraju predati opsežnu dokumentaciju i dokazati objektivan razlog, najčešće zdravstveni.

Spolni odgoj ondje traje od treće do 16. godine, a dobna granica stalno se spuštala. Najprije se smatralo da je srednja škola prekasno jer učenici već imaju ugrađene moralne obrasce. Zatim se prigovaralo da djeca u prvi razred dolaze s već razvijenom "heteronormativnošću i cisnormativnošću". Gošća to ironično komentira: djeca imaju majku i oca, pa ih to "valjda navodi" na takvo shvaćanje. Prema njezinim riječima, u većini tih zemalja djeca od treće godine dolaze "na indoktrinaciju", dva do tri puta mjesečno moraju biti odjevena kao suprotni spol i već tada slušaju o različitim rodnim identitetima. Svjesna je da to prosječnom Hrvatu zvuči nadrealno.

magisterium.assessment: Naglašavanje prava roditelja da sudjeluju u odgoju djece i da biraju obrazovanje u skladu sa svojim moralnim i vjerskim uvjerenjima načelno je usklađeno s katoličkim naukom. Ipak, odlomak iznosi tvrdnje o francuskom kurikulumu i ograničenjima školovanja kod kuće koje se iz dostavljenih izvora ne mogu provjeriti, a izraz „degutantan” polemički je sud umjesto teološkog obrazloženja.
concerns: Nije potkrijepljena tvrdnja da je francuski program obvezan u katoličkim školama niti opis konkretnih administrativnih ograničenja školovanja kod kuće; te se tvrdnje ne mogu ocijeniti kao činjenice na temelju dostupnog materijala.
Kritika državne uloge ne bi trebala zanemariti da katoličko shvaćanje roditeljskih prava ne znači da su ta prava apsolutna niti da je svaka državna obrazovna mjera nepravedna.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk roditelje smatra prvim i temeljnim odgojiteljima te traži da škola, uključujući seksualni odgoj, surađuje s njima i poštuje načelo supsidijarnosti. Država zato ima pomoćnu ulogu, ali roditeljsko pravo nije apsolutno: odgoj mora služiti dobru i dostojanstvu djeteta te biti u skladu s moralnim zakonom.

magisterium.assessment_en: Emphasizing the right of parents to participate in the education of their children and to choose education in accordance with their moral and religious beliefs is in principle aligned with Catholic teaching. However, the passage makes claims about the French curriculum and homeschooling restrictions that cannot be verified from the provided sources, and the term "disgusting" is a polemical judgment rather than a theological explanation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching considers parents to be the primary and fundamental educators and requires that the school, including sex education, cooperate with them and respect the principle of subsidiarity. The state therefore has an auxiliary role, but parental rights are not absolute: education must serve the good and dignity of the child and be in accordance with the moral law.
concerns_en: The claim that the French program is mandatory in Catholic schools is not substantiated, nor is the description of specific administrative restrictions on homeschooling; these claims cannot be evaluated as facts based on the available material.
Criticism of the state's role should not overlook that the Catholic understanding of parental rights does not mean that these rights are absolute, nor that every state educational measure is unjust.

sections.subtitle_en: France: mandatory curriculum from age three and restricted homeschooling
sections.screenshot_description_en: Josipa Nemet describes the experiences of French parents with the national sex education curriculum
sections.content_en:
Josipa Nemet mentions a conference to which parents from **France** were invited, where, as she says, the program has reached "its extreme limits". She calls the French national curriculum "disgusting" and points out that it is mandatory even in Catholic schools. Therefore, the Croatian rhetoric about withdrawing children from the program is insufficient for French circumstances.

French parents began homeschooling their children, but the state, she says, restricted that to the maximum as well. Unlike America, where it is enough to say "I want to homeschool", in France parents must submit extensive documentation and prove an objective reason, most often a medical one.

Sex education there lasts from age three to 16, and the age limit has constantly been lowered. At first, it was considered that high school was too late because students already have ingrained moral patterns. Then objections were raised that children enter first grade with already developed "heteronormativity and cisnormativity". The guest comments ironically on this: children have a mother and a father, so that "presumably leads" them to such an understanding. According to her, in most of those countries children from the age of three arrive "for indoctrination", have to be dressed as the opposite sex two to three times a month, and already at that age listen about various gender identities. She is aware that this sounds surreal to the average Croat.

sections.subtitle: Obitelji koje se iz Njemačke vraćaju zbog ideološkog sadržaja
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća govori o obiteljima koje se vraćaju iz Njemačke, a voditelj nadovezuje svoja saznanja
sections.content:
Da to nije nadrealno, Josipa Nemet potkrepljuje primjerom: u posljednja dva mjeseca saznala je za pet ili šest obitelji koje se iz **Njemačke** vraćaju isključivo zbog izloženosti djece ekstremnom ideološkom i seksualiziranom sadržaju u vrtiću ili školi. "To je naša stvarnost", kaže. Zadaća je, prema njezinim riječima, pobrinuti se da mjesto u koje se te obitelji vraćaju za deset godina ne postane isto onome od čega su pobjegle.

Voditelj dodaje da je i sam čuo za takve programe u Njemačkoj. Roditelji ondje djecu ispisuju na tjedan ili dva dok sporni sadržaj ne prođe, a zatim ih vraćaju u školu. Ocjenjuje da ni to nije sretno rješenje i da rad gošće i njezine udruge treba podržati.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na to da roditelji trebaju štititi djecu i imati važnu ulogu u njihovu odgoju u skladu je s katoličkim naukom, koji roditelje smatra primarnima i nezamjenjivima u odgoju, uključujući spolni i afektivni odgoj. Ipak, odlomak ne iznosi konkretne podatke o navodnim sadržajima ni neovisnu potvrdu anegdote, pa se njegove optužujuće oznake i zaključak o njemačkim programima ne mogu teološki potvrditi samo na temelju iznesenoga.
concerns: Tvrdnja da se pet ili šest obitelji vraća iz Njemačke isključivo zbog određenih programa prenesena je kao anegdota, bez dodatne provjere; nije dovoljno potkrijepljena da bi se iz nje izvodio opći zaključak o njemačkim vrtićima ili školama.

Izrazi poput „ekstremni ideološki i seksualizirani sadržaj” ostaju neodređeni jer odlomak ne navodi konkretne nastavne materijale ili postupke. Takav jezik može pojačati strah i polarizaciju ako se ne potkrijepi činjeničnom analizom.

Katoličko načelo roditeljskog prvenstva u odgoju ne znači da je svaki školski program neprimjeren niti da je svaka tvrdnja o njemu točna; procjena zahtijeva razlikovanje provjerljivih sadržaja od političkih ili polemičkih uopćavanja.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva uči da je obitelj primarno odgojno okruženje te da roditelji imaju ozbiljnu i nezamjenjivu odgovornost za cjelovit, pa i spolni i afektivni odgoj djece, dok škole i drugi odgojitelji trebaju podupirati tu odgovornost. Biblijski prikaz obiteljskog odgoja naglašava prenošenje mudrosti i osposobljavanje djece da razlikuju istinu od privida, a ne samo njihovu zaštitu od vanjskih utjecaja. Zato je opravdano tražiti da se obrazovni sadržaji poštuju dostojanstvo djece i uvjerenja roditelja, ali katolička procjena treba biti činjenično utemeljena, razborita i pravedna prema osobama i ustanovama o kojima se govori.

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis that parents should protect children and have an important role in their upbringing is in accordance with Catholic teaching, which considers parents primary and irreplaceable in upbringing, including sexual and affective education. However, the passage does not present concrete data about the alleged contents nor independent confirmation of the anecdote, so its accusatory labels and conclusion about German programs cannot be theologically confirmed solely on the basis of what is presented.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church teaches that the family is the primary educational environment and that parents have a serious and irreplaceable responsibility for the integral, including sexual and affective, education of children, while schools and other educators should support that responsibility. The biblical account of family upbringing emphasizes the transmission of wisdom and enabling children to discern truth from appearance, and not merely their protection from external influences. Therefore, it is justified to demand that educational contents respect the dignity of children and the convictions of parents, but a Catholic assessment should be factually grounded, prudent, and just toward the persons and institutions spoken of.
concerns_en: The claim that five or six families are returning from Germany exclusively because of certain programs is conveyed as an anecdote, without additional verification; it is not sufficiently substantiated to draw a general conclusion from it about German kindergartens or schools.

Expressions such as "extreme ideological and sexualized content" remain indefinite because the passage does not cite concrete teaching materials or procedures. Such language can intensify fear and polarization if not substantiated by factual analysis.

The Catholic principle of parental primacy in education does not mean that every school program is inappropriate nor that every claim about it is accurate; discernment requires distinguishing verifiable contents from political or polemical generalizations.

sections.subtitle_en: Families returning from Germany due to ideological content
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest speaks about families returning from Germany, and the host adds his own insights
sections.content_en:
That this is not surreal, Josipa Nemet substantiates with an example: in the last two months she has learned of five or six families returning from **Germany** exclusively due to the children's exposure to extreme ideological and sexualized content in kindergarten or school. "That is our reality," she says. The task, according to her words, is to make sure that the place to which these families return does not in ten years become the same as what they fled from.

The host adds that he himself has heard about such programs in Germany. Parents there withdraw their children for a week or two until the disputed content passes, and then return them to school. He assesses that this is not a happy solution either and that the work of the guest and her association should be supported.

sections.subtitle: Bitka za djetinjstvo počinje kod kuće: kriza djetinjstva zapravo je kriza roditeljstva
sections.screenshot_description: Josipa Nemet objašnjava da je današnja kriza djetinjstva prvenstveno kriza roditeljstva
sections.content:
Na početku drugog dijela razgovora voditelj se nadovezuje na priče o njemačkim programima spolnog odgoja. Ondje, kako je čuo, roditelji ispisuju djecu iz nastave na tjedan ili dva dok sporni sadržaji ne prođu. Takvo rješenje ne smatra najsretnijim, ali ističe da rad udruge zaslužuje podršku. Zatim razgovor širi izvan teme seksualizacije. Spominje konferenciju **Bitka za djetinjstvo** u organizaciji udruge Članak 64 i pita kakva se još bitka vodi za djecu, osim one u obrazovnom sustavu.

Dr. sc. Josipa Nemet odgovara da je srž te bitke činjenica da se dijete **prerano gura iz djetinjstva u odraslost**. To se ne događa samo kroz školski sustav, nego kroz cijeli javni prostor, od jumbo plakata do televizijskih serija. Ipak, ključni problem vidi drugdje: roditeljstvo se, kaže, jako promijenilo. Njezina je teza jasna: **današnja kriza djetinjstva prvenstveno je kriza roditeljstva.**

Tehnologija koja utječe na djecu jednako snažno utječe i na roditelje, a to je, prema njezinim riječima, na nevjerojatan način promijenilo odgoj. Dijete od najranije dobi treba prisutnost roditelja, a nedostaje već i fizička prisutnost jer djeca s godinu dana idu u jaslice. Taj podatak Nemet naziva „doslovno tragedijom“ i tvrdi da ne postoji znanstveno ni biološko utemeljenje po kojemu bi to bilo dobro za dijete.

No djetetu nije dovoljna samo fizička prisutnost. Nedostaje mu, kako kaže, **roditeljski pogled**, jer „dijete se sluša očima“. Svaka majka može posvjedočiti da joj dijete, dok nešto priča, stalno okreće glavu prema sebi. Roditelji, smatra Nemet, nisu svjesni koliko ta pozornost znači za razvoj dječje neurobiologije i za njegovo urastanje u zdrav identitet. Dijete identitet gradi prvenstveno kroz **osnovni relacijski trokut: majku, oca i sebe**. Taj odnos je „priručnik“ koji dijete čita i kroz koji gleda vlastiti život. Promjene u posljednjih 20 do 30 godina, zaključuje, na djeci se itekako vide.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na roditeljskoj odgovornosti za odgoj djece i njihovu spolnu formaciju u skladu je s katoličkim naukom, koji roditelje smatra prvotnim odgojiteljima, a školu suradnikom pod načelom supsidijarnosti. Ipak, odlomak uglavnom postavlja temu i prenosi anegdotu o njemačkim roditeljima; ne iznosi dovoljno sadržaja da bi se procijenili daljnji zaključci sugovornice.
concerns: Izraz „bitka za djetinjstvo” i spominjanje „ideologije” mogu unaprijed usmjeriti raspravu prema alarmističkom okviru ako se ne razjasni na koje se konkretne sadržaje ili postupke odnose.

Anegdota o ispisivanju djece iz nastave nije potkrijepljena pojedinostima, a odlomak ne objašnjava kako bi roditelji trebali razborito procijeniti konkretan program; voditelj, međutim, kaže da to ne smatra najsretnijim rješenjem.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva uči da su roditeljsko pravo i dužnost odgoja „izvorni i prvotni” te da ih se ne može potpuno predati drugima niti ih drugi mogu prisvojiti; školska suradnja treba poštovati njihovu odgovornost i načelo supsidijarnosti. To ne znači da se roditeljski odgoj svodi na protivljenje spolnom odgoju: katolička formacija treba djeci prikazati spolnost kao dar i uključiti čistoću, poštovanje osobe i moralnu odgovornost. ()

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on parental responsibility for the education of children and their sexual formation is in accordance with Catholic teaching, which regards parents as the primary educators and the school as a collaborator under the principle of subsidiarity. Still, the passage mostly introduces the topic and conveys an anecdote about German parents; it does not present enough content to assess the interlocutor's further conclusions.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church teaches that the parental right and duty of education are "original and primary" and that they cannot be completely delegated to others, nor can others usurp them; school collaboration must respect their responsibility and the principle of subsidiarity. This does not mean that parental education is reduced to opposition to sex education: Catholic formation should present sexuality to children as a gift and include chastity, respect for the person, and moral responsibility. ()
concerns_en: The phrase "battle for childhood" and the mention of "ideology" can pre-emptively steer the discussion toward an alarmist framework if it is not clarified which specific content or procedures they refer to.

The anecdote about withdrawing children from classes is not supported by details, and the passage does not explain how parents should prudently evaluate a specific program; the host, however, says that he does not consider this the most fortunate solution.

sections.subtitle_en: The battle for childhood begins at home: the crisis of childhood is actually a crisis of parenting
sections.screenshot_description_en: Josipa Nemet explains that today's crisis of childhood is primarily a crisis of parenting
sections.content_en:
At the beginning of the second part of the conversation, the host follows up on stories about German sex education programs. There, as he heard, parents withdraw their children from classes for a week or two until the controversial content has passed. He does not consider such a solution the most fortunate, but he emphasizes that the work of the association deserves support. Then he broadens the conversation beyond the topic of sexualization. He mentions the conference **Bitka za djetinjstvo** organized by the association Članak 64 and asks what other battle is being waged for children, besides the one in the educational system.

Dr. sc. Josipa Nemet replies that the core of this battle is the fact that a child is **pushed prematurely from childhood into adulthood**. This does not happen only through the school system, but through the entire public sphere, from billboards to television series. Nevertheless, she sees the key problem elsewhere: parenting, she says, has changed greatly. Her thesis is clear: **today's crisis of childhood is primarily a crisis of parenting.**

The technology that affects children affects parents just as strongly, and that, according to her words, has changed upbringing in an incredible way. From the earliest age, a child needs the presence of parents, and even physical presence is already lacking because children go to nursery at one year of age. Nemet calls that fact "literally a tragedy" and claims that there is no scientific or biological foundation according to which this would be good for a child.

Yet physical presence alone is not enough for a child. It lacks, as she says, **the parental gaze**, because "a child is listened to with the eyes." Every mother can testify that, while talking about something, her child constantly turns her head toward itself. Parents, Nemet believes, are not aware of how much this attention means for the development of the child's neurobiology and for its growing into a healthy identity. A child builds identity primarily through **the basic relational triangle: mother, father, and itself**. That relationship is the "manual" that the child reads and through which it views its own life. The changes in the last 20 to 30 years, she concludes, are very much visible in children.

sections.subtitle: Zanemarujući i permisivni odgoj kao istoznačnice: zašto djeci treba „odgoj za žrtvu“
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća govori o odgoju za žrtvu i važnosti odgode trenutnog užitka
sections.content:
Josipa Nemet zatim imenuje obrazac koji smatra najraširenijim: **zanemarujući odgoj**. Dodaje da danas ne vidi razliku između zanemarujućeg i permisivnog odgoja jer su joj to, kako kaže, istoznačnice. Roditelji su, objašnjava, prestali odgajati svjesno i počeli **instantno ugađati svakoj dječjoj potrebi i svakom nagonu**.

Opasnost vidi u tome što se djecu tako sprječava u onome što naziva **odgojem za žrtvu**. Cijeli ljudski život, tumači, traži žrtvu ako se želi stvoriti nešto kvalitetno. Čovjek mora odgoditi trenutni užitak zbog nečega dobrog u budućnosti. Upravo zato su ljudi, za razliku od životinja, bića koja mogu predviđati i planirati.

Tu se Nemet poziva na pojam **„dovoljno dobre majke i oca“**: roditelja koji djetetu omogućuju razdoblja blage frustracije. Između „želim“ i „imam“ mora postojati odmak. Taj odmak nije samo odgojna, nego i neurobiološka kategorija:

- u tom prostoru stvaraju se **tanke regulacijske sinapse**;
- ponavljanjem odgojnih metoda one se utvrđuju i podebljavaju;
- s vremenom ih dijete **internalizira**, pa mu kao zrelom više ne treba vanjska modulacija roditelja.

Zaključak gošće je da u današnjem odgoju izrazito nedostaje frustracije. Voditelj dodaje da nedostaje i granica kod roditelja, s čime se gošća odmah slaže.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na to da djeca trebaju učiti odgađati zadovoljstvo, razvijati samosvladavanje i vježbati nesebičnost uglavnom je usklađen s katoličkim razumijevanjem odgoja i kršćanskog života. Ipak, poistovjećivanje zanemarujućeg i permisivnog odgoja preširoko je i može zamagliti razliku između zanemarivanja djeteta i pretjeranog popuštanja njegovim željama.
concerns: Zanemarujući i permisivni odgoj nisu nužno istoznačnice: odlomak ih izjednačuje bez obrazloženja, a katolički pristup zahtijeva razborito razlikovanje odgojnih problema.
Izraz „ugađati svakoj dječjoj potrebi i svakom nagonu” treba precizirati: djetetove stvarne potrebe traže odgovoran odgovor roditelja, dok se ne mora udovoljiti svakoj želji ili porivu.
Govoreći o „odgoju za žrtvu”, korisno je naglasiti da kršćanska žrtva znači samodarivanje iz ljubavi, a ne opravdavanje zanemarivanja djetetove dostojanstvene potrebe ili nametanja tuđih želja.
magisterium.enrichment: Amoris laetitia ističe da odgađanje želja nije njihovo poricanje, nego njihovo odgađanje do prikladnog trenutka; takva praksa pomaže djeci rasti u samosvladavanju i odgovornoj slobodi. Crkveni dokument o odgoju djece također preporučuje roditeljima poticati velikodušnost i samoodricanje, dok istodobno upozorava da odgoj ne smije ni sve podrediti djetetovim željama ni zanemariti njegovo dostojanstvo i prava. Kršćanski smisao žrtve povezan je s ljubavlju i nesebičnim služenjem drugima, a ne sa žrtvovanjem djeteta ili njegovih opravdanih potreba.

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on children needing to learn to delay gratification, develop self-control, and practice selflessness is largely aligned with the Catholic understanding of upbringing and Christian life. Nevertheless, equating neglectful and permissive parenting is too broad and may blur the distinction between neglecting a child and excessively giving in to their desires.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Amoris laetitia emphasizes that delaying desires is not their denial, but rather postponing them until an appropriate moment; such practice helps children grow in self-control and responsible freedom. The Church's document on the education of children also recommends that parents encourage generosity and self-denial, while simultaneously warning that upbringing must neither subordinate everything to the child's desires nor neglect their dignity and rights. The Christian meaning of sacrifice is linked to love and selfless service to others, rather than to sacrificing the child or their legitimate needs.
concerns_en: Neglectful and permissive parenting are not necessarily synonyms: the passage equates them without explanation, and a Catholic approach requires a prudent distinction between parenting problems.
The phrase "catering to every child's need and every impulse" needs clarification: a child's real needs require a responsible response from parents, while not every desire or urge must be indulged.

Speaking of "upbringing for sacrifice", it is useful to emphasize that Christian sacrifice means self-giving out of love, rather than justifying the neglect of the child's dignified needs or the imposition of others' desires.

sections.subtitle_en: Neglectful and permissive parenting as synonyms: why children need "upbringing for sacrifice"
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest speaks about upbringing for sacrifice and the importance of delaying immediate pleasure
sections.content_en:
Josipa Nemet then names the pattern she considers the most widespread: **neglectful parenting**. She adds that today she sees no difference between neglectful and permissive parenting because to her, as she says, they are synonyms. Parents, she explains, have stopped raising children consciously and have begun **instantly catering to every child's need and every impulse**.

She sees danger in the fact that children are thus prevented from what she calls **upbringing for sacrifice**. The entirety of human life, she explains, demands sacrifice if one wishes to create something of quality. A person must delay immediate pleasure for the sake of something good in the future. That is precisely why humans, unlike animals, are beings that can anticipate and plan.

Here Nemet refers to the concept of **"the good-enough mother and father"**: parents who provide the child with periods of mild frustration. Between "I want" and "I have" there must be a distance. That distance is not only a pedagogical, but also a neurobiological category:

- in that space, **thin regulatory synapses** are created;
- through the repetition of parenting methods, they are established and thickened;
- over time the child **internalizes** them, so that as an adult they no longer need external modulation from parents.

The guest's conclusion is that today's upbringing sorely lacks frustration. The host adds that boundaries among parents are also lacking, with which the guest immediately agrees.

sections.subtitle: Ograđeni vrt, blagodat dosade i sjećanje na žeđ s košarkaškog igrališta
sections.screenshot_description: Josipa Nemet objašnjava zašto su dosada i igra temelj dječje samoregulacije
sections.content:
Granice, objašnjava Josipa Nemet, djetetu daju sigurnost. Uspoređuje ih s **ograđenim vrtom** u kojemu dijete ima svu slobodu, ali vrt mora imati ogradu, jer je dijete bez nje frustrirano. Kad mu se daje autonomija, dijete ne zna što bi s njom. Njegova biologija još nema dijelove mozga koji tom autonomijom mogu upravljati. Autonomiju će rado prihvatiti, ali će je iskoristiti preko **nagradnog sustava**: stvarat će si užitak, igrati igrice „bjesomučno“, prejedati se ili tražiti stalnu validaciju na društvenim mrežama. To posljednje, napominje, podiže dopamin, osobito kod djevojčica.

Najopasnijim smatra **izostanak dosade**. Dosada je, prema njoj, najvažniji oblik frustracije za dijete jer ga potiče da stvara i da se igra. Zato je **igra najkvalitetniji oblik stimulacije nagradnog sustava**. U igri s drugima dijete se mora prilagoditi i pričekati jer je netko drugi prvi uzeo igračku. Mali „šutevi dopamina“, potrebni za motivaciju, isprekidani su čekanjem. Upravo iz toga nastaju regulacija i sposobnost samokontrole.

Danas, upozorava, djeca ne samo da nemaju dosade, nego dobivaju jesti prije nego što su gladna i piti prije nego što su žedna. Kao primjer navodi prijateljice koje djecu stalno šalju da popiju vode, iako će se dijete samo napiti kad ožedni. Usporedbe radi, prisjeća se vlastitog djetinjstva. Igrala je košarku, nije bilo boca s vodom kakve danas svi nose, a do vodoskoka vani nije joj se dalo ići. Djeca su tada znala što su žeđ i glad, a važnije im je bilo pucati na koš nego odmah piti.

Takve situacije Nemet naziva važnim neurobiološkim događajima za razvoj samokontrole. One u konačnici razvijaju i sposobnost da se čovjek jednog dana **žrtvuje**, ne samo za vlastito dobro, nego i za dobro osobe koja mu je važna. Zato se, zaključuje, ne treba čuditi što je danas toliko ljudi koji se za drugoga ne žele žrtvovati.

magisterium.assessment: Središnja tvrdnja da djeci trebaju primjerene granice i pomoć u razvijanju samokontrole uglavnom je usklađena s katoličkim razumijevanjem roditeljske odgojne odgovornosti. Ipak, tvrdnje da dijete bez granica nužno postaje frustrirano te da autonomiju koristi ponajprije za traženje užitka zvuče preopćenito i traže nijansiranje.
concerns: Tvrdnja da djetetova biologija još nema dijelove mozga potrebne za upravljanje autonomijom nije teološka tvrdnja, a u odlomku nije potkrijepljena; bilo bi preciznije govoriti o postupnom razvoju sposobnosti prosuđivanja i samoregulacije.

Usporedba s ograđenim vrtom može dobro dočarati zaštitne granice, ali ako se shvati kao opravdanje za pretjerano nadziranje ili gušenje djetetove osobnosti, ne bi bila u skladu s potrebom da disciplina poštuje djetetovo dostojanstvo i potiče njegov rast.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički odgojni pristup podupire granice koje djetetu pomažu da postupno razvija odgovornost, odgađa zadovoljstvo i usmjerava slobodu prema dobru; sloboda sama po sebi ne jamči zrelost. Ipak, disciplina treba biti poticaj napretku, a ne obeshrabrenje, i mora izbjegavati i popuštanje svakoj želji i oduzimanje djetetova dostojanstva ili prava. Roditelji trebaju prilagoditi odgoj dobi i sposobnostima djeteta te ga voditi prema suradnji, samosvladavanju i poštovanju drugih.

magisterium.assessment_en: The central claim that children need appropriate boundaries and help in developing self-control is largely aligned with the Catholic understanding of parental educational responsibility. However, the claims that a child without boundaries necessarily becomes frustrated and uses autonomy primarily to seek pleasure sound too generalized and require nuance.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic educational approach supports boundaries that help the child gradually develop responsibility, delay gratification, and direct freedom toward the good; freedom in itself does not guarantee maturity. However, discipline should be an encouragement to progress, not a discouragement, and must avoid both giving in to every desire and stripping away the child's dignity or rights. Parents should adapt upbringing to the child's age and abilities and guide them toward cooperation, self-mastery, and respect for others.
concerns_en: The claim that a child's biology does not yet have the parts of the brain needed to manage autonomy is not a theological claim, and in the passage it is not substantiated; it would be more precise to speak of the gradual development of the capacity for judgment and self-regulation.

The comparison to a fenced garden can illustrate protective boundaries well, but if understood as a justification for excessive surveillance or stifling the child's personality, it would not be in accordance with the need for discipline to respect the child's dignity and foster their growth.

sections.subtitle_en: The fenced garden, the blessing of boredom, and the memory of thirst from the basketball court
sections.screenshot_description_en: Josipa Nemet explains why boredom and play are the foundation of children's self-regulation
sections.content_en:
Boundaries, Josipa Nemet explains, give a child security. She compares them to a **fenced garden** in which the child has all freedom, but the garden must have a fence, because without it the child is frustrated. When given autonomy, the child does not know what to do with it. Its biology does not yet have the parts of the brain that can manage that autonomy. It will gladly accept autonomy, but will use it through the **reward system**: it will create pleasure for itself, play games „frantically“, overeat, or seek constant validation on social networks. The latter, she notes, raises dopamine, especially in girls.

She considers the **absence of boredom** to be the most dangerous. Boredom is, according to her, the most important form of frustration for a child because it encourages it to create and to play. That is why **play is the highest quality form of stimulation of the reward system**. In play with others, the child must adapt and wait because someone else took the toy first. Small „dopamine shots“, necessary for motivation, are interrupted by waiting. It is precisely from this that regulation and the capacity for self-control arise.

Today, she warns, children not only lack boredom, but are given food before they are hungry and drink before they are thirsty. As an example, she cites friends who constantly send their children to drink water, even though a child will drink on its own when it gets thirsty. By way of comparison, she recalls her own childhood. She played basketball, there were no water bottles like everyone carries today, and she did not feel like going outside to the drinking fountain. Children back then knew what thirst and hunger were, and it was more important to them to shoot hoops than to drink right away.

Nemet calls such situations important neurobiological events for the development of self-control. They ultimately also develop the capacity for a person to one day **sacrifice**, not only for their own good, but also for the good of a person who is important to them. That is why, she concludes, one should not be surprised that today there are so many people who do not want to sacrifice for another.

sections.subtitle: Lekcija iz Japana: ni besplatni spojevi ne pomažu kad se izgubi smisao majčinstva
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća navodi primjer Japana i neuspjeh demografskih mjera
sections.content:
Kao krajnju posljedicu odgoja bez žrtve Josipa Nemet navodi **Japan**. Ondje ljudi, kaže, ne žele ulaziti u brakove, pa ni u veze, jer ih doživljavaju kao nepotrebnu smetnju koja traži odricanje. Roditelji koji su se odlučili na djecu ondje su, prema njezinim riječima, „povlaštena skupina“.

S tim primjerom kritizira i domaći demografski pristup koji se svodi na olakšice. Japanci imaju gotovo sve besplatno, od sportskih aktivnosti nadalje, a država daje čak i **bonove za odlazak na spoj**. Unatoč tome ljude ne uspijeva potaknuti ni na veze ni na brak, a kamoli na djecu. Problem je, zaključuje, negdje drugdje: djeca se više ne odgajaju **za majčinstvo i očinstvo**.

Nekada je to bilo nagonski: djevojčica je od rođenja gledala svoju majku. Nemet poručuje majkama da paze što govore pred djecom. Ne treba verbalno veličati majčinstvo, ali ne treba ni pred djecom prepričavati traume s poroda i neprestano govoriti koliko je sve teško. Ženi je, smatra, teško jer su joj nametnute uloge koje biološki ne može nositi istodobno. Uz to ju se uvjerilo da je važnije „na traci micati čepove“ nego stvarati „nova vječna bića“. To naziva **laži i varkom nametnutom ženi**: da vrijedi manje ako se posveti novom životu nego ako je „rob na blagajni ili na traci“.

Gošća naglašava da obrazovanje smatra važnim jer je i sama doktorica znanosti. Ipak, nitko je ne može uvjeriti da je jedan dan njezina rada ili jedno slovo znanstvenog rada važnije od toga da zakasni po dijete u vrtić. To je, kaže, bilo jasno svakom njezinom poslodavcu. Prisjeća se i čuđenja okoline kad je odlučila tri godine ostati kod kuće s djetetom: „Zar ćeš ti to napraviti?“ Takvo razmišljanje pripisuje društvu u koje su ljudi urasli. Oni ne shvaćaju da to nije odricanje, nego **izbor boljega**.

magisterium.assessment: Kritika shvaćanja braka i obitelji kao nepotrebne smetnje koja traži odricanje uglavnom je usklađena s katoličkim naglaskom na vjernosti, predanom ljubavi i velikodušnosti roditeljstva. Ipak, opis japanskog društva i tvrdnja da državne pogodnosti ne pomažu jer je izgubljen smisao majčinstva izneseni su kao široka uzročno-posljedična dijagnoza koju priloženi izvori ne potvrđuju.
concerns: Iz dostupnog odlomka ne može se provjeriti tvrdnja da ljudi u Japanu općenito izbjegavaju brakove i veze, da su roditelji ondje „povlaštena skupina” ili da su bonovi za spojeve i druge pogodnosti nedjelotvorni.
Demografski problemi prikazani su kao posljedica gubitka smisla majčinstva i nespremnosti na žrtvu, ali odlomak ne daje osnovu za tako jednoznačno objašnjenje niti razmatra druge moguće čimbenike.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko učenje prepoznaje brak kao doživotni savez i obiteljski život kao poziv koji uključuje velikodušnost, dok se strah od trajne obveze i sebično traženje užitka navode kao sile koje mogu ugroziti obiteljski život. To ne znači da svatko mora stupiti u brak ili postati roditelj: Crkva također prepoznaje celibat i djevičanstvo za Kraljevstvo kao zasebne pozive.

citations.document_title: 19 February 1981: Mass for families, Cebu City, Philippines
Christus vivit
Acta Apostolicae Sedis: Issue 10, October, 2013

magisterium.assessment_en: The criticism of understanding marriage and family as an unnecessary hindrance that demands sacrifice is largely aligned with the Catholic emphasis on fidelity, committed love, and the generosity of parenthood. Nevertheless, the description of Japanese society and the assertion that state benefits do not help because the meaning of motherhood has been lost are presented as a broad cause-and-effect diagnosis that the attached sources do not confirm.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching recognizes marriage as a lifelong covenant and family life as a vocation that includes generosity, while fear of permanent commitment and the selfish pursuit of pleasure are cited as forces that can jeopardize family life. This does not mean that everyone must enter into marriage or become a parent: the Church also recognizes celibacy and virginity for the Kingdom as distinct vocations.
concerns_en: From the available excerpt, it cannot be verified whether people in Japan generally avoid marriages and relationships, whether parents there are a „privileged group”, or whether dating vouchers and other benefits are ineffective.

Demographic problems are presented as a consequence of the loss of the meaning of motherhood and an unwillingness to sacrifice, but the excerpt provides no basis for such an unequivocal explanation, nor does it consider other possible factors.

sections.subtitle_en: A lesson from Japan: not even free dates help when the meaning of motherhood is lost
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest cites the example of Japan and the failure of demographic measures
sections.content_en:
As an extreme consequence of upbringing without sacrifice, Josipa Nemet cites **Japan**. There, she says, people do not want to enter into marriages, or even relationships, because they perceive them as an unnecessary hindrance that demands sacrifice. Parents who have decided to have children are there, according to her words, a „privileged group”.

With that example, she also criticizes the domestic demographic approach that comes down to concessions. The Japanese have almost everything for free, from sports activities onward, and the state even gives **vouchers for going on a date**. Despite that, it fails to encourage people either into relationships or into marriage, let alone to have children. The problem, she concludes, is elsewhere: children are no longer being raised **for motherhood and fatherhood**.

In the past, it was instinctive: a little girl watched her mother from birth. Nemet tells mothers to watch what they say in front of children. Motherhood does not need to be verbally glorified, but neither should one recount childbirth traumas in front of children and constantly talk about how difficult everything is. For a woman, she believes, it is difficult because roles have been imposed on her that she biologically cannot carry at the same time. In addition, she has been convinced that it is more important to „move caps on an assembly line” than to create „new eternal beings”. She calls this a **lie and a deceit imposed on a woman**: that she is worth less if she devotes herself to new life than if she is a „slave at the cash register or on the assembly line”.

The guest emphasizes that she considers education important because she herself is a doctor of science. Nevertheless, no one can convince her that one day of her work or one letter of a scientific paper is more important than being late to pick up her child from kindergarten. That, she says, was clear to every employer of hers. She also recalls the astonishment of those around her when she decided to stay at home with her child for three years: „Are you really going to do that?” She attributes such thinking to the society people have grown into. They do not realize that this is not sacrifice, but **the choice of the better**.

sections.subtitle: Zbunjeni roditelji i pogrešni savjeti: zašto bebu ne treba ostaviti da se isplače
sections.screenshot_description: Josipa Nemet govori o pogrešnim savjetima stručnjaka i trajnim posljedicama na razini gena
sections.content:
Najviše joj je, kaže Josipa Nemet, žao same djece, jer su im **roditelji zbunjeni**. Zbunili su ih „raznorazni stručnjaci“ koji su posljednjih 20 do 30 godina davali dvojbene savjete. Kao primjer navodi raširenu tvrdnju da je dijete dobro **ostaviti da se isplače** umjesto da ga se utješi.

Desetljećima kasnije, ističe, znanstvena istraživanja pokazala su posljedice takvog pristupa na najdubljoj razini, onoj gena. To se područje izravno tiče **transkripcije**, kojom se gošća i sama bavi. Prema njezinim riječima, dolazi do reorganizacija koje ostaju trajne kroz cijeli život. Takve osobe ostaju **hipersenzibilne i teško se nose sa stresom** jer ih kao bebe nitko nije mazio, njegovao i nosio. Zato se, kako slikovito kaže, „nisu popalili promotori“ koji su se trebali aktivirati.

U detalje ne ulazi, ali naglašava opće načelo: **što je raniji stadij neurorazvoja, to obrazac ide dublje** u djetetovu neurobiologiju i teže ga je kasnije reintegrirati.

Voditelj iz toga izvodi zaključak da se tako stvara kaos: roditelji se udaljavaju od djece, a država tada preuzima odgoj preko škola.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na utjehi i pažljivoj brizi za dojenče uglavnom je usklađen s katoličkim poštovanjem dostojanstva djeteta i pozivom roditeljima da mu pruže ljubav i skrb. Međutim, tvrdnja da ostavljanje djeteta da plače uzrokuje određene posljedice na razini gena nije sama po sebi katolički nauk i iz ovog odlomka nije moguće procijeniti je li znanstveno dovoljno potkrijepljena.
concerns: Empirijsku tvrdnju o posljedicama na razini gena treba prikazati oprezno i precizno, a ne kao zaključak koji proizlazi iz katoličkog nauka ili Svetoga pisma.
Odlomak ne razlikuje moguće pristupe umirivanju djeteta ni okolnosti pojedine obitelji, pa se ne može zaključiti da svaki roditelj koji primijeni određenu metodu postupa neodgovorno.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk traži posebnu brigu za djecu, osobito za najmanje i najovisnije, te ističe da roditeljska ljubav uključuje emocionalnu i materijalnu skrb. Isusovo prihvaćanje djece i poziv da ih se ne priječi pružaju biblijski kontekst za nježnost i zaštitu, ali ne propisuju pojedinu metodu uspavljivanja ili tješenja. Zato je važno odvojiti moralno načelo brižne ljubavi od znanstvenih tvrdnji o stresu i transkripciji gena, koje treba vrednovati prema odgovarajućim dokazima.

citations.document_title: Familiaris Consortio
Acta Apostolicae Sedis: Issue 10, 2017

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on comforting and attentive care for an infant is largely aligned with the Catholic respect for the dignity of the child and the call to parents to provide it with love and care. However, the claim that leaving a child to cry causes certain consequences at the gene level is not in itself Catholic teaching, and from this excerpt it is not possible to assess whether it is sufficiently supported scientifically.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching calls for special care for children, especially for the smallest and most dependent, and emphasizes that parental love includes emotional and material care. Jesus' acceptance of children and the call not to hinder them provide a biblical context for tenderness and protection, but do not prescribe a specific method of putting to sleep or comforting. Therefore, it is important to separate the moral principle of caring love from scientific claims about stress and gene transcription, which should be evaluated according to appropriate evidence.
concerns_en: The empirical claim about consequences at the gene level should be presented cautiously and precisely, and not as a conclusion arising from Catholic teaching or Sacred Scripture.

The excerpt does not distinguish between possible approaches to soothing a child nor the circumstances of an individual family, so it cannot be concluded that every parent who applies a certain method acts irresponsibly.

sections.subtitle_en: Confused parents and mistaken advice: why a baby should not be left to cry it out
sections.screenshot_description_en: Josipa Nemet speaks about mistaken advice from experts and lasting consequences at the gene level
sections.content_en:
Most of all, Josipa Nemet says, she feels sorry for the children themselves, because their **parents are confused**. They were confused by “all sorts of experts” who have been giving questionable advice over the last 20 to 30 years. As an example, she cites the widespread claim that it is good **to leave a child to cry it out** instead of comforting it.

Decades later, she points out, scientific research has shown the consequences of such an approach at the deepest level, that of genes. That area directly concerns **transcription**, which the guest herself works on. According to her words, reorganizations occur that remain permanent throughout life. Such persons remain **hypersensitive and have a hard time dealing with stress** because no one cuddled, nurtured, and carried them as babies. That is why, as she picturesquely puts it, “the promoters did not turn on” that were supposed to activate.

She does not go into details, but emphasizes the general principle: **the earlier the stage of neurodevelopment, the deeper the pattern goes** into the child's neurobiology and the harder it is to reintegrate later.

The host draws the conclusion from this that chaos is created in this way: parents distance themselves from children, and the state then takes over upbringing through schools.

sections.subtitle: Suglasnost i budnost: kako roditelji mogu zaštititi djecu od ideologije u školi
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća objašnjava ulogu roditeljske suglasnosti i roditeljske budnosti

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na roditeljskoj odgovornosti, praćenju spolnog odgoja izvan doma i mogućnosti da roditelji povuku dijete iz pouke koja ne odgovara njihovim načelima uglavnom je usklađen s katoličkim naukom. Ipak, tvrdnju da se školski sadržaji protive „svakom svjetonazoru i logici” treba potkrijepiti konkretnim primjerima, a ne generalizirati o zdravstvenom odgoju kao takvom.
concerns: Odlomak ne navodi koji su točno sadržaji sporni, pa se ne može utvrditi proturječe li doista katoličkom nauku ili su samo predstavljeni kao ideološki.
Povlačenje djeteta iz neprikladne pouke ne oslobađa roditelje obveze da mu pruže odgovarajuću, dobi primjerenu formaciju.
Tvrdnju o pravnom statusu programa i obveznoj suglasnosti roditelja nije moguće provjeriti samo na temelju ovog odlomka.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk priznaje roditelje kao prve i nezamjenjive odgojitelje, ali ne potiče pretjeranu kontrolu ni izoliranje djece od širega društvenog života. Katolička je smjernica pratiti spolni odgoj izvan obitelji i, kada nije u skladu s roditeljskim načelima, razmotriti povlačenje djeteta, uz istodobnu dužnost pružanja primjerene formacije; zato budnost treba biti razborita, činjenično utemeljena i usmjerena na dobro djeteta.

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on parental responsibility, monitoring sex education outside the home, and the possibility for parents to withdraw a child from instruction that does not conform to their principles is largely in alignment with Catholic teaching. However, the claim that school content goes against “every worldview and logic” should be substantiated with concrete examples, rather than generalizing about health education as such.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching recognizes parents as the primary and irreplaceable educators, but does not encourage excessive control or the isolation of children from broader social life. The Catholic guideline is to monitor sex education outside the family and, when it is not in accordance with parental principles, to consider withdrawing the child, along with the simultaneous duty to provide appropriate formation; therefore, vigilance should be prudent, fact-based, and directed toward the good of the child.
concerns_en: The passage does not specify which contents are specifically controversial, so it cannot be determined whether they truly contradict Catholic teaching or are merely presented as ideological.
Withdrawing a child from inappropriate instruction does not exempt parents from the obligation to provide the child with appropriate, age-suitable formation.
The claim regarding the legal status of the program and mandatory parental consent cannot be verified solely on the basis of this passage.

sections.subtitle: Prvi spolni odgoj odvija se u dnevnom boravku: kako se majka i otac odnose jedno prema drugome
sections.screenshot_description: Josipa Nemet objašnjava da je odnos majke i oca najvažniji spolni odgoj za dijete
sections.content:
S obzirom na to da je malo vremena ostalo, voditelj prelazi na pitanja koja smatra najvažnijima za gledatelje. Podsjeća da je Josipa Nemet **majka petero djece, četiri kćeri i jednog sina**, a ona potvrđuje da njezina najstarija kći ima 15 godina. Voditelj pita kako, kada i na koji način razgovarati s djecom o seksualnosti, razlikuje li se pristup prema spolu djeteta i kako se uključuje njezin suprug. Napominje da roditelji tu temu najčešće prepuštaju satu razrednika i drugima, iako bi to trebali činiti sami.

Gošća odgovara da najvažniji spolni odgoj počinje **još prije rođenja**. Dijete u maternici čuje majčin glas, njezinu nježnost, pa i očev glas. Temelj spolnog odgoja je **odnos majke i oca**, odnosno odnos muškog i ženskog u koji dijete urasta. Dijete promatra kako se roditelji jedno drugome obraćaju, kako se dodiruju i kako se dočekuju kad netko dođe kući. Tako tjelesni dodir povezuje s nečim lijepim, ugodnim i relacijskim. Pojam relacije još ne poznaje, ali vidi da dodir stvara zajedništvo između ljudi koje voli.

Roditelji se, nastavlja, često uplaše kad se posvađaju pred djetetom. Navodi slučaj roditelja koji su se nakon svađe išli ispričati djetetu. Njezin savjet bio je da su se trebali ispričati jedno drugome. Dijete je povrijeđeno zato što su roditelji povrijedili jedno drugo, pa se i njegova obnova događa kroz **pomirenje roditelja**. Dijete je vrlo plastično i otvoreno za obnovu, a pomirenje roditelja, kaže, obnovit će svaku ranu.

Djevojčica, objašnjava Nemet, gradi svoju ženstvenost gledajući majku koja voli svoju ženstvenost i uživa u njezinoj ljepoti i nježnosti. U ocu istodobno vidi zaštitu i snagu: tata je heroj, „najjači na svijetu“, a majka tu sliku podržava. To je, prema njoj, presudno za duboke intrinzične strukture i zdrav neurobiološki razvoj. Druga strana to naziva **patrijarhatom**, na što gošća odgovara da je onda „valjda i sama biologija patrijarhalna“. Protivnici bi se s njom trebali boriti znanstvenim radovima, a ne na verbalnoj razini.

magisterium.assessment: Prikaz je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim naukom: roditelji imaju prvenstveno i nezamjenjivo pravo i dužnost odgajati djecu u spolnosti, a njihov uzajamni odnos može biti važan primjer za djecu. Budući da je dostavljeni sadržaj samo sažetak koji prekida usred rečenice, nije moguće procijeniti sve tvrdnje podcasta ni način na koji obrađuje temu.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveno učenje naglašava da roditelji ne smiju potpuno prepustiti spolni odgoj školi ili drugim ustanovama, premda te ustanove mogu surađivati pod njihovim vodstvom. Spolnost se odgaja kao dimenzija cijele osobe i poziv na ljubav i darivanje sebe, a ne samo kao biološka tema; svjedočanstvo majke i oca može podupirati takav odgoj, uz poštovanje jednake dostojanstvenosti žena i muškaraca.

magisterium.assessment_en: The presentation is largely in alignment with Catholic teaching: parents have the primary and irreplaceable right and duty to educate children in sexuality, and their mutual relationship can be an important example for children. Since the provided content is only a summary that breaks off mid-sentence, it is not possible to assess all claims of the podcast or the way it addresses the topic.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching emphasizes that parents must not completely leave sex education to school or other institutions, although these institutions may cooperate under their guidance. Sexuality is educated as a dimension of the whole person and a call to love and self-giving, and not merely as a biological topic; the witness of mother and father can support such education, with respect for the equal dignity of women and men.

sections.subtitle_en: The first sex education takes place in the living room: how mother and father relate to one another
sections.screenshot_description_en: Josipa Nemet explains that the relationship between mother and father is the most important sex education for a child
sections.content_en:
Considering that little time remains, the host moves on to the questions he considers most important for the viewers. He recalls that Josipa Nemet is a **mother of five children, four daughters and one son**, and she confirms that her oldest daughter is 15 years old. The host asks how, when, and in what way to talk to children about sexuality, whether the approach differs according to the child's sex, and how her husband gets involved. He notes that parents most often leave this topic to the homeroom class and to others, even though they should do it themselves.

The guest responds that the most important sex education begins **even before birth**. A child in the womb hears the mother's voice, her tenderness, and also the father's voice. The foundation of sex education is **the relationship between mother and father**, that is, the relationship between male and female into which the child grows. The child observes how the parents address each other, how they touch each other, and how they greet each other when someone comes home. Thus, the child connects physical touch with something beautiful, pleasant, and relational. The child does not yet know the concept of relation, but sees that touch creates communion between the people they love.

Parents, she continues, often get frightened when they argue in front of the child. She mentions the case of parents who went to apologize to the child after an argument. Her advice was that they should have apologized to each other. The child is hurt because the parents hurt each other, so its restoration also occurs through the **reconciliation of the parents**. The child is very plastic and open to restoration, and the parents' reconciliation, she says, will restore every wound.

A girl, Nemet explains, builds her femininity by watching her mother, who loves her femininity and enjoys its beauty and tenderness. At the same time, she sees protection and strength in her father: dad is a hero, "the strongest in the world," and the mother supports that image. This is, according to her, crucial for deep intrinsic structures and healthy neurobiological development. The other side calls this **patriarchy**, to which the guest replies that then "biology itself is probably patriarchal too." Opponents should fight her with scientific papers, not on a verbal level.

sections.subtitle: Od potrebe za nježnošću do faze latencije: što roditelji trebaju znati o ranim fazama
sections.screenshot_description: Gošća opisuje ranodječju fazu, potrebu za nježnošću i fazu latencije
sections.content:
Dok je dijete malo, kaže Josipa Nemet, takav primjer roditelja je dovoljan i ništa drugo ne treba. Malo dijete svoje potrebe u velikoj mjeri zadovoljava **dodirom i nježnošću**. Ako nježnosti nedostaje, dijete je može tražiti samo, nadraživanjem dijelova tijela na kojima ima živčane završetke. Aktivisti to, napominje, nazivaju masturbacijom. Ona to opisuje kao **dječje nadraživanje** kojim dijete zadovoljava potrebu za nježnošću.

Savjet roditeljima je da djetetovu pažnju **preusmjere**, da ga uzmu, druže se s njim i maze ga. Tada se dijete „napije roditelja“ i te nježnosti, pa iz takvog ponašanja prirodno izraste. U određenoj dobi i samo instinktivno shvati da to ne radi pred drugima. Ključno je **ne napadati dijete** i ne stvoriti mu dojam da nešto nije u redu s njegovim tijelom, jer ono osjeća samo ugodu. Česta je pogreška, kaže, što se roditelji tada šokiraju, iako je riječ o posve normalnom stadiju.

Slijedi **faza latencije** u kojoj se gubi interes za tu tjelesnu ugodu. To je, ističe, vrlo važno razdoblje predadolescencije. Dijete se prirodno okreće prema van: prema zajednici, učenju i stjecanju iskustva. U mozgu se događa „ogromna sinaptička eksplozija“, pa je dijete poput **spužve za kulturu**. Tada mu roditelji polako mogu prenositi osnove.

Najbolje je, savjetuje, pričekati da dijete samo postavi pitanja. Hoće li ih postaviti, ovisi o tome ima li prisan odnos s roditeljem i je li tema stigmatizirana. Odgovori moraju biti prilagođeni dobi. Roditelji se mogu i sami educirati iz „predivnih knjiga“ o razgovoru s djecom o seksualnosti, a udruga, dodaje gošća, organizira i **radionice o tome kako s djecom razgovarati o spolnosti**.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na to da roditelji odgovore nježnošću, blizinom i preusmjeravanjem pažnje može biti u skladu s kršćanskom brigom za dijete, a crkvene smjernice doista traže blag i razborit pristup ranim tjelesnim navikama. Ipak, tvrdnja da je dječje genitalno nadraživanje prvenstveno nadomjestak za manjak nježnosti nije utvrđena u priloženim crkvenim izvorima te može previše pojednostaviti uzroke ponašanja.
concerns: Objašnjenje da dijete takvim ponašanjem zadovoljava potrebu za nježnošću izneseno je kao uzročna tvrdnja, ali priložene smjernice ne potvrđuju da je manjak nježnosti opće ili glavno objašnjenje; preporučuju razborito utvrđivanje mogućih uzroka i, kada je potrebno, savjetovanje s kvalificiranim stručnjacima.

Naziv „dječje nadraživanje” može korisno razlikovati ponašanje malog djeteta od svjesnog, moralno odgovornog čina odrasle osobe, ali ne bi smio služiti poricanju da se radi o genitalnom ponašanju koje roditelji mogu blago usmjeravati. Crkvene smjernice govore o ranom genitalnom ponašanju i preporučuju nježno ispravljanje navika koje bi se kasnije mogle razviti u grešne navike.

Odlomak ne razrađuje razliku između samog ponašanja djeteta i njegove osobne moralne krivnje. Smjernice nalažu blagu korekciju u pozitivnom okviru dostojanstva, a ne posramljivanje ili automatsko pripisivanje pune moralne odgovornosti.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički pristup drži zajedno nježnu roditeljsku skrb i odgoj za čistoću: roditelji mogu djetetovu pažnju preusmjeriti i pružiti mu blizinu, a pritom mirno učiti skromnosti i primjerenom odnosu prema tijelu. Crkvene smjernice također upozoravaju da odgoj treba tražiti uzroke teškoća, a ne samo izravno suzbijati njihovu pojavu, te po potrebi uključiti stručno osposobljene osobe.
